title: Rivaroxaban Is No Better Than Aspirin After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation at Least 1 Year Earlier.
Active Helicobacter pylori Infection and Atrial Fibrillation in Patients Hospitalized With Acute Myocardial Infarction.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Chronic Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection may promote systemic inflammation and has been proposed as a contributor to atrial fibrillation (AF), but clinical evidence is inconsistent. The aim of the study was to explore whether active H. pylori infection was associated with AF in patients hospitalized with acute myocardial infarction (AMI).

METHODS: This cross-sectional analysis included adults from a two-center observational AMI cohort. Active H. pylori infection was assessed during hospitalization using a urea breath test (UBT). AF was defined as AF documented before admission or identified during the index hospitalization. Associations were estimated using logistic regression adjusted for age, sex, center, and smoking. Exploratory multivariable interaction analyses were also performed.

RESULTS: Of 310 enrolled patients, 300 had conclusive H. pylori screening results; 60 (20.0%) were positive. AF was recorded in 4 of 60 H. pylori-positive patients (6.7%) and 30 of 240 H. pylori-negative patients (12.5%). H. pylori positivity was not significantly associated with recorded AF (unadjusted OR, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.17-1.41; p = 0.228; adjusted OR, 0.54; 95% CI, 0.16-1.46; p = 0.235). These estimates refer to pooled AF; only four AF cases occurred among patients testing positive.

CONCLUSIONS: No statistically significant association was detected between H. pylori breath-test positivity and pooled documented AF among patients hospitalized with AMI, but a clinically meaningful association cannot be excluded. Larger prospective studies with longitudinal follow-up are needed to clarify whether active H. pylori infection is associated with incident AF after AMI.

AI.tldr: 在接受幽门螺杆菌尿素呼气试验筛查的310例急性心肌梗死住院患者中，活动性幽门螺杆菌感染与房颤无显著关联（校正OR 0.54，95%CI 0.16-1.46，P=0.235），但因事件数少不能排除临床相关关联。
AI.motivation: 慢性幽门螺杆菌感染可诱发全身炎症，因而被提出可能参与房颤的发生机制，但既往临床证据并不一致。本研究旨在急性心肌梗死住院人群这一房颤高危、炎症活跃的背景下，检验活动性幽门螺杆菌感染与房颤是否存在关联，以填补该人群中的证据缺口。
AI.method: 两中心观察性 AMI 队列的横断面分析，纳入成人患者310例，其中300例有明确的幽门螺杆菌筛查结果。活动性感染采用住院期间尿素呼气试验（UBT）判定；房颤定义为入院前已记录或在本次住院期间发现的房颤（合并统计）。采用 logistic 回归估计关联，校正年龄、性别、研究中心与吸烟，并进行探索性多因素交互分析。
AI.result: 幽门螺杆菌阳性60例（20.0%）。房颤在阳性组发生4/60（6.7%），阴性组30/240（12.5%）。幽门螺杆菌阳性与房颤记录无显著关联：未校正 OR 0.55（95%CI 0.17-1.41，P=0.228），校正 OR 0.54（95%CI 0.16-1.46，P=0.235）。上述估计针对合并房颤终点，且阳性组仅4例房颤事件。摘要未报告交互分析的具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 在急性心肌梗死住院患者中，尿素呼气试验提示的活动性幽门螺杆菌感染与房颤之间未检出统计学显著关联，但点估计偏向负相关，且阳性组事件数极少、置信区间宽，因此不能排除具有临床意义的关联。现有证据不足以支持将幽门螺杆菌筛查或根除用于房颤风险评估；需要样本量更大、具备纵向随访的前瞻性研究，明确活动性感染与新发房颤的关系。局限性包括横断面设计无法判断时序性、终点为入院前与住院期间房颤的合并定义、单次呼气试验及事件数少导致统计效能不足。

summary_zh:
目的：慢性幽门螺杆菌（H. pylori）感染可能促进全身性炎症，并被认为与心房颤动（AF）有关，但临床证据并不一致。本研究旨在探讨在急性心肌梗死（AMI）住院患者中，活动性 H. pylori 感染是否与 AF 相关。

方法：本横断面分析纳入来自一个两中心观察性 AMI 队列的成人患者。活动性 H. pylori 感染在住院期间通过尿素呼气试验（UBT）进行评估。AF 定义为入院前已记录的 AF，或本次住院期间发现的 AF。采用 logistic 回归估计相关性，并对年龄、性别、中心及吸烟进行调整。此外还进行了探索性多变量交互作用分析。

结果：在 310 例入组患者中，300 例具有明确的 H. pylori 筛查结果；60 例（20.0%）为阳性。60 例 H. pylori 阳性患者中有 4 例（6.7%）记录到 AF，240 例 H. pylori 阴性患者中有 30 例（12.5%）记录到 AF。H. pylori 阳性与记录的 AF 无显著相关性（未调整 OR，0.55；95% CI，0.17-1.41；p = 0.228；调整后 OR，0.54；95% CI，0.16-1.46；p = 0.235）。这些估计值针对的是合并 AF；在检测阳性的患者中仅发生 4 例 AF。

结论：在 AMI 住院患者中，未检测到 H. pylori 呼气试验阳性与合并记录 AF 之间存在统计学显著相关性，但不能排除具有临床意义的相关性。需要开展更大规模、具有纵向随访的前瞻性研究，以明确活动性 H. pylori 感染是否与 AMI 后新发 AF 相关。

title: Log-transformed systemic inflammation response index improves prediction of 28-day ICU mortality in critically ill patients with cirrhosis and atrial fibrillation: development in MIMIC-IV and external validation in eICU-CRD.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Short-term mortality is high among critically ill patients with cirrhosis and atrial fibrillation (AF). Existing scores such as SOFA, MELD-Na, and CHA₂DS₂-VASc do not directly reflect systemic inflammation. We investigated whether blood count-derived inflammatory indices could improve prediction of 28-day ICU mortality in this high-risk population.

METHODS: Adult ICU patients with cirrhosis and AF were identified from MIMIC-IV v3.1 (single-center development cohort) and eICU-CRD v2.0 (multicenter external validation cohort). Five inflammatory indices, including SIRI, log-SIRI, SII, log-SII, and NLR, were compared by adding each marker to a base model of age, sex, SOFA, and MELD-Na. The final model was developed using multivariable logistic regression. Internal validation used 1000-resample bootstrap, and performance was assessed by discrimination, calibration, reclassification, and decision curve analysis.

RESULTS: A total of 454 patients from MIMIC-IV and 121 from eICU-CRD were included. The 28-day ICU mortality rates were 19.6% and 16.5%, respectively. Among the five candidate markers, SII achieved the highest AUC (0.758) and lowest AIC, but its per-unit odds ratio (1.0001) made point-based nomogram construction impractical. log-SIRI was selected for its interpretable per-unit odds ratio (1.48) and near-identical discrimination to SII (ΔAUC - 0.007), together with the biological argument that its three-lineage formulation avoids platelet count, which is unreliable in cirrhosis. Adding log-SIRI to the base model increased the AUC from 0.721 to 0.751 (ΔAUC + 0.030, DeLong P = 0.026) and improved model fit on likelihood ratio testing (χ² = 9.18, P = 0.002), with concordant improvement in continuous NRI (0.241, P = 0.037) and calibration (Hosmer-Lemeshow P 0.002 to 0.729). The optimism-corrected C-index was 0.734. External validation in eICU-CRD yielded an AUC of 0.818.

CONCLUSION: Log-SIRI was associated with 28-day ICU mortality after adjustment for age, sex, SOFA, and MELD-Na. The improvement in AUC over the base clinical model was modest but statistically significant, corroborated by concordant improvements in likelihood ratio, continuous NRI, and calibration. Prospective external calibration is needed before individual clinical use.

AI.tldr: 在肝硬化合并房颤的危重患者中，将 log-SIRI 加入由年龄、性别、SOFA、MELD-Na 构成的基础模型可小幅但显著改善 28 天 ICU 死亡预测（AUC 0.721→0.751），eICU-CRD 外部验证 AUC 0.818。
AI.motivation: 肝硬化合并 AF 的危重患者短期死亡风险高，而现有 SOFA、MELD-Na、CHA₂DS₂-VASc 等评分均不直接反映系统性炎症状态。血常规衍生的炎症指标（SIRI、SII、NLR）获取便捷、成本低，但其在该高危人群中能否为常规临床模型提供增量预测价值尚缺乏验证，本研究即针对这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究。研究对象为成人 ICU 中肝硬化合并 AF 的患者：开发队列取自 MIMIC-IV v3.1（单中心，n=454），外部验证队列取自 eICU-CRD v2.0（多中心，n=121）。暴露/候选预测因子为 5 种血常规衍生炎症指标（SIRI、log-SIRI、SII、log-SII、NLR），逐一加入由年龄、性别、SOFA 与 MELD-Na 构成的基础模型进行比较。最终模型采用多因素 logistic 回归构建，主要终点为 28 天 ICU 死亡。内部验证采用 1000 次重抽样 bootstrap，模型性能通过判别力、校准度、重分类（连续 NRI）及决策曲线分析评估。
AI.result: 开发队列与验证队列的 28 天 ICU 死亡率分别为 19.6% 与 16.5%。5 个候选指标中 SII 的 AUC 最高（0.758），AIC 最低，但其每单位 OR 仅 1.0001，难以据此构建基于评分的列线图；log-SIRI 每单位 OR 为 1.48，判别力与 SII 几乎相同（ΔAUC −0.007），且其公式包含三系细胞、不含在肝硬化中不可靠的血小板计数，故最终选用 log-SIRI。将 log-SIRI 加入基础模型后，AUC 由 0.721 升至 0.751（ΔAUC +0.030，DeLong P=0.026），似然比检验显示模型拟合改善（χ²=9.18，P=0.002），连续 NRI 为 0.241（P=0.037），校准度亦改善（Hosmer-Lemeshow P 由 0.002 升至 0.729）。bootstrap 校正后 C-index 为 0.734；eICU-CRD 外部验证 AUC 为 0.818（外部验证的校准指标摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: 在校正年龄、性别、SOFA 与 MELD-Na 后，log-SIRI 与肝硬化合并 AF 危重患者的 28 天 ICU 死亡相关；其相对基础临床模型的判别力提升幅度不大，但有统计学意义，并得到似然比检验、连续 NRI 与校准度改善的一致支持。该指标仅需血常规即可获得，具备床旁快速风险分层潜力；但开发队列为单中心、样本量与事件数有限，外部验证仅报告判别力而未报告校准，故在用于个体化临床决策前仍需前瞻性外部校准研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：肝硬化合并心房颤动（AF）的危重症患者短期死亡率较高。SOFA、MELD-Na 和 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 等现有评分不能直接反映全身炎症。我们探讨了血细胞计数衍生的炎症指标能否改善对该高危人群 28 天 ICU 死亡率的预测。

方法：从 MIMIC-IV v3.1（单中心开发队列）和 eICU-CRD v2.0（多中心外部验证队列）中识别出合并肝硬化和 AF 的成人 ICU 患者。通过将 SIRI、log-SIRI、SII、log-SII 和 NLR 等五种炎症指标分别加入由年龄、性别、SOFA 和 MELD-Na 构成的基础模型进行比较。最终模型采用多变量 logistic 回归开发。内部验证采用 1000 次重抽样 bootstrap，并通过区分度、校准度、重分类和决策曲线分析评估性能。

结果：共纳入来自 MIMIC-IV 的 454 例患者和来自 eICU-CRD 的 121 例患者。28 天 ICU 死亡率分别为 19.6% 和 16.5%。在五种候选标志物中，SII 的 AUC 最高（0.758）、AIC 最低，但其每单位比值比为 1.0001，使基于评分点的列线图构建不切实际。选择 log-SIRI 是因其每单位比值比（1.48）可解释、对 SII 的区分度几乎相同（ΔAUC - 0.007），并且其基于三系细胞的公式避免使用在肝硬化中不可靠的血小板计数，这一生物学论据也支持其选择。将 log-SIRI 加入基础模型后，AUC 从 0.721 增至 0.751（ΔAUC + 0.030，DeLong P = 0.026），似然比检验显示模型拟合改善（χ² = 9.18，P = 0.002），连续 NRI（0.241，P = 0.037）和校准度（Hosmer-Lemeshow P 0.002 至 0.729）也呈一致性改善。乐观校正 C 指数为 0.734。在 eICU-CRD 中进行外部验证得到的 AUC 为 0.818。

结论：在校正年龄、性别、SOFA 和 MELD-Na 后，log-SIRI 与 28 天 ICU 死亡率相关。相对于基础临床模型，AUC 的改善幅度不大但具有统计学意义，并得到似然比、连续 NRI 和校准度一致性改善的佐证。在个体临床使用前，需要进行前瞻性外部校准。

title: Association Between Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI) and Glycemic Control (HbA1c) in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
Atrial Cardiomyopathy in Patients with Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome: Non-Invasive Characterization (ATRIO-CKM).
summary: Background/Objectives: In cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome, left atrium (LA) involvement begins early: reservoir function declines before the chamber dilates, and the resulting atrial cardiomyopathy (ACM) precedes atrial fibrillation (AF), heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), and cardioembolic stroke. How ACM is distributed across CKM stages has not yet been characterized in routine clinical practice. ATRIO-CKM aims to characterize ACM non-invasively across the range of CKM stages in patients assessed in an internal medicine and cardiology department and to identify the parameters most strongly associated with ACM within CKM syndrome. Methods: Single-center, prospective, observational study with cross-sectional phenotyping at the index visit. We will enroll consecutive adults at their first assessment in our department (target, 200; minimum, 150). The primary objective is to estimate the stage-specific prevalence of ACM among participants in sinus rhythm without documented AF, who form the main cohort and are grouped as CKM with versus without ACM. Patients in sinus rhythm are phenotyped with 12-lead electrocardiogram (P-wave duration, Bayés interatrial block), echocardiography with speckle-tracking of the left ventricle (LV), LA (biplane reservoir, conduit, and contractile strain), and right ventricular (RV) free wall, and biomarkers including MR-proANP, Fetuin-A, FGF-23, and NT-proBNP, with cardiac magnetic resonance in an exploratory subset. Participants with AF documented at any time, including previously documented paroxysmal AF, are allocated to a separate established-AF cohort irrespective of the rhythm at the index visit. Results: We will report ACM prevalence by CKM stage with confidence intervals, the profile separating the two groups, LA volume index across three groups of increasing severity (no ACM, ACM in sinus rhythm, and established AF), and the parameters associated with ACM. Conclusions: Using only measurements already available in routine cardiology, ATRIO-CKM will describe how ACM is distributed across CKM stages and identify the parameters most strongly associated with ACM within CKM syndrome, as candidates for a classification index to be developed and validated in a larger cohort.

AI.tldr: ATRIO-CKM 研究方案提出仅用常规心电、超声斑点追踪应变与生物标志物，在 CKM 综合征各期中无创刻画心房心肌病，主要终点为分期患病率；摘要尚未报告任何结果。
AI.motivation: 在心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）综合征中，左心房受累出现很早：储器功能在房腔扩大之前即已下降，由此形成的心房心肌病（ACM）先于 AF、射血分数保留的心衰（HFpEF）和心源性栓塞性卒中发生。然而，ACM 在各 CKM 分期中如何分布，在常规临床实践中尚未得到描述；同时缺乏可直接用于分层、且不依赖复杂检查的无创指标。ATRIO-CKM 旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心、前瞻性、观察性研究，在索引访视时进行横断面表型刻画。连续纳入在我院内科学与心内科首次就诊的成人，目标样本量 200 例（最少 150 例）。主要队列为窦性心律且无 AF 记录者，按 CKM 是否合并 ACM 分为两组，主要目标为估计各 CKM 分期的 ACM 患病率；任何时间记录到 AF（含既往阵发性 AF）者不论索引访视时心律如何，均归入独立的“已确诊 AF”队列。窦律患者接受：12 导联心电图（P 波时限、Bayés 房间传导阻滞）、超声心动图斑点追踪（左室、左房双平面储器/管道/收缩应变、右室游离壁）、生物标志物（MR-proANP、Fetuin-A、FGF-23、NT-proBNP），并在探索性亚组中行心脏磁共振。次要分析包括区分两组的表型特征、三组（无 ACM、窦律下 ACM、已确诊 AF）间左房容积指数梯度，以及与 ACM 相关的参数。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何结果：本文为研究方案，仅描述拟采用的方法学与计划分析（各 CKM 分期 ACM 患病率及置信区间、组间表型差异、三组左房容积指数、与 ACM 相关的参数），未提供效应量、95%CI 或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 该方案的意义在于，仅使用心脏科日常可获得的测量，描述 ACM 在 CKM 各期的分布并筛选与 ACM 最强的相关参数，作为后续在更大队列中开发与验证分类指数的候选。局限性：单中心、横断面设计、样本量有限、无随访结局，且所识别的关联不能推断因果；摘要未报告可行性数据与中期结果。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：在心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）综合征中，左心房（LA）受累始于早期：储器功能在腔室扩大之前即已下降，由此形成的心房心肌病（ACM）先于心房颤动（AF）、射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）和心源性栓塞性卒中发生。ACM 在 CKM 各分期中如何分布，尚未在常规临床实践中得到描述。ATRIO-CKM 旨在对在内科和心内科接受评估的患者中、跨越 CKM 各分期的 ACM 进行无创性特征描述，并确定 CKM 综合征中与 ACM 关联最强的参数。方法：单中心、前瞻性、观察性研究，在索引访视时进行横断面表型分析。我们将连续纳入在我科首次接受评估的成人（目标 200 例；最少 150 例）。主要目标是在无 AF 记录的窦性心律参与者中估计 ACM 的分期特异性患病率，这些参与者构成主要队列，并分为伴 ACM 与不伴 ACM 的 CKM 两组。窦性心律患者接受以下表型评估：12 导联心电图（P 波时限、Bayés 房间传导阻滞）、超声心动图（对左心室（LV）、LA（双平面储器、管道和收缩期应变）以及右心室（RV）游离壁进行斑点追踪），以及包括 MR-proANP、Fetuin-A、FGF-23 和 NT-proBNP 在内的生物标志物，并在一个探索性子集中进行心脏磁共振。任何时候记录到 AF 的参与者，包括既往记录到的阵发性 AF，无论索引访视时的心律如何，均被分配至单独的已确诊 AF 队列。结果：我们将报告按 CKM 分期划分的 ACM 患病率及其置信区间、区分两组的特征谱、三个严重程度递增组（无 ACM、窦性心律下的 ACM、已确诊 AF）的 LA 容积指数，以及与 ACM 相关的参数。结论：ATRIO-CKM 仅使用常规心脏病学中已可获得的测量指标，将描述 ACM 在 CKM 各分期中的分布，并确定 CKM 综合征中与 ACM 关联最强的参数，作为待在一个更大队列中开发和验证的分类指数的候选参数。

title: Echocardiographic Framework for Left Atrial Appendage Morphology Assessment and Thromboembolic Risk Stratification in Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: Background: Left Atrial Appendage (LAA) causes a thrombus risk in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Accurate identification of LAA morphology reduces thrombotic stroke. Methods: This study proposes a hybrid deep learning framework, Left Atrial Appendage Thrombus Framework (LAATF), which integrates Adaptive CLAHE, optimized Chan-Vese contour extraction, and a multi-headed AgileFormer transformer to classify LAA morphology, detect thrombus, and estimate image-derived thromboembolic risk using the LightGBM-based proposed Thromboembolic Risk index (TRI) score. A dataset of 4320 temporal images from 240 patients with AF was used, comprising four LAA morphologies (chicken-wing, windsock, cactus, and cauliflower). CLAHE enhanced local contrast. The Chan-Vese model delineated appendage contours. AgileFormer extracted image-derived textural and morphological features to classify morphology and thrombus presence. LightGBM-based TRI regression estimated thromboembolic risk in AF patients with LAA. Results: The proposed framework achieved a morphology classification accuracy of 91-94% and thrombus detection AUC of 0.935, with a sensitivity of 93.4% and specificity of 92.6%. The computed TRI correlated strongly with actual outcomes (R2 = 0.98, r = 0.99). Among morphologies, cauliflower and cactus types show the highest thromboembolic risk due to their increased texture entropy and image-based features. Conclusions: The LAATF framework provides an interpretable, image-based technique for LAA morphology assessment and thrombus prediction.

AI.tldr: 基于240例AF患者4320幅时序超声图像的LAATF深度学习框架，LAA形态分类准确率91-94%，血栓检测AUC 0.935，并显示菜花型与仙人掌型血栓栓塞风险最高。
AI.motivation: AF患者左心耳（LAA）内血栓形成是缺血性卒中的重要来源，准确识别LAA形态有助于分层血栓栓塞风险并指导抗凝与左心耳封堵等决策；但既往依赖人工判读经食道超声，主观性强、可重复性有限，缺乏可解释的自动化形态分类与血栓检测工具。
AI.method: 单中心影像组学/深度学习建模研究，纳入240例AF患者的4320幅时序超声图像，覆盖鸡翅型、风向袋型、仙人掌型、菜花型四种LAA形态。框架由自适应CLAHE局部对比度增强、优化的Chan-Vese轮廓提取、多头AgileFormer Transformer（提取纹理与形态特征，完成形态分类与血栓检测）以及基于LightGBM的 thromboembolic risk index（TRI）回归评分构成；终点为形态分类准确率、血栓检测的AUC/敏感度/特异度，以及TRI与实际血栓栓塞结局的相关性。摘要未报告训练/验证集划分、参考标准判读者及统计检验方法。
AI.result: 形态分类准确率91-94%；血栓检测AUC 0.935，敏感度93.4%，特异度92.6%；基于影像计算的TRI与实际结局高度相关（R²=0.98，r=0.99）。按形态分层，菜花型与仙人掌型的血栓栓塞风险最高，作者归因于其纹理熵及影像特征更高。摘要未报告各终点的95%置信区间与P值。
AI.conclusion: LAATF提供了一种可解释的、基于超声图像的LAA形态评估与血栓预测方法，有望辅助AF患者血栓栓塞风险分层。局限性在于样本量较小（240例）、缺乏外部验证与前瞻性结局验证，TRI的临床阈值与相对于CHADS₂-VASc等现有评分的增量价值尚待明确。

summary_zh:
背景：左心耳（LAA）在心房颤动（AF）患者中会带来血栓风险。准确识别LAA形态可减少血栓性卒中。

方法：本研究提出一种混合深度学习框架——左心耳血栓框架（LAATF），其整合了自适应CLAHE、优化的Chan-Vese轮廓提取以及多头AgileFormer transformer，用于对LAA形态进行分类、检测血栓，并使用基于LightGBM提出的血栓栓塞风险指数（TRI）评分来估计影像衍生的血栓栓塞风险。研究使用了包含240例AF患者共4320幅时序图像的数据集，涵盖四种LAA形态（鸡翅型、风向袋型、仙人掌型和菜花型）。CLAHE增强了局部对比度。Chan-Vese模型勾画了心耳轮廓。AgileFormer提取影像衍生的纹理和形态特征，以对形态和血栓存在情况进行分类。基于LightGBM的TRI回归估计了伴有LAA的AF患者的血栓栓塞风险。

结果：所提出的框架实现了91–94%的形态分类准确率和0.935的血栓检测AUC，灵敏度为93.4%，特异度为92.6%。计算得到的TRI与实际结局强相关（R2 = 0.98，r = 0.99）。在各形态中，菜花型和仙人掌型由于纹理熵和基于影像的特征增加而表现出最高的血栓栓塞风险。

结论：LAATF框架为LAA形态评估和血栓预测提供了一种可解释的、基于影像的技术。

title: Atrial fibroblast metabolic reprogramming in atrial fibrillation: a candidate mechanism within multicellular atrial cardiomyopathy
Latent class analysis-derived patterns of comorbidities in patients with atrial fibrillation, adherence to integrated care and impact on long-term outcomes: an analysis from a prospective cohort.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) commonly coexists with multiple cardiovascular (CV) and non-CV comorbidities, which may cluster in distinct clinical phenotypes with different outcome implications.

OBJECTIVE: We aim to identify comorbidity-based phenotypes in AF using latent class analysis (LCA), characterize their clinical course and assess the association of integrated care adherence with outcomes across phenotypes.

METHODS: A LCA based on 11 conditions (CV and non-CV) was performed. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause death, thromboembolic (TE) events, and acute coronary syndrome (ACS). Secondary outcomes were all-cause death and ACS/TE events.

RESULTS: We included 1233 AF patients (median age 75 [66-82] years, females 37.5%). Four clinical LCA-derived phenotypes were identified: "Low comorbidity" (31.5%); "Cardio-metabolic" (33.9%); "Elderly comorbid" (22.9%); and "Atherosclerotic-HF" (11.8%). During a median follow-up of 542 days, 234 patients (22.7%) experienced the primary outcome. Compared to "Low comorbidity", "Cardio-metabolic" (aHR 1.64, 95% CI 1.13-2.39), "Elderly comorbid" (aHR 1.62, 95% CI 1.09-2.42) and "Atherosclerotic-HF" (aHR 2.81, 95%CI 1.83-4.34) phenotypes were independently associated with a higher risk of the primary outcome. Adherence to integrated care varied across phenotypes and was associated with a lower risk of adverse events, with no evidence of significant heterogeneity across phenotypes (p int=0.157).

CONCLUSIONS: Latent class analysis identified distinct AF clinical phenotypes characterized by specific patterns of comorbidities and associated with different risk of adverse outcomes. The absence of significant heterogeneity in the association between integrated care and outcomes across phenotypes supports its potential value across different levels of clinical complexity in AF patients.

AI.tldr: 在1233例房颤患者中，潜在类别分析识别出4种共病表型，其不良结局风险不同；整合管理依从性与较低不良事件风险相关，且各表型间无显著异质性。
AI.motivation: 房颤常合并多种心血管和非心血管共病，这些共病可能聚集为不同临床表型并影响预后。既往证据对房颤共病表型的系统识别不足，且整合管理依从性在不同表型中的预后价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于前瞻性队列的分析，纳入1233例房颤患者，中位年龄75（66-82）岁，女性37.5%。采用潜在类别分析（LCA）基于11种心血管和非心血管共病识别表型。主要终点为全因死亡、血栓栓塞（TE）事件和急性冠脉综合征（ACS）的复合终点；次要终点为全因死亡及ACS/TE事件。中位随访542天，采用调整后风险比（aHR）及95%CI评估表型与结局的关联，并以交互作用P值检验整合管理依从性在不同表型间的异质性；摘要未报告整合管理依从性的具体定义和评估方式。
AI.result: 识别出4种表型：低共病型31.5%、心血管代谢型33.9%、老年共病型22.9%、动脉粥样硬化-心衰型11.8%。随访期间234例（22.7%）发生主要终点。与低共病型相比，心血管代谢型（aHR 1.64，95%CI 1.13-2.39）、老年共病型（aHR 1.62，95%CI 1.09-2.42）和动脉粥样硬化-心衰型（aHR 2.81，95%CI 1.83-4.34）的主要终点风险显著升高。整合管理依从性在不同表型间存在差异，并与较低的不良事件风险相关，各表型间无显著异质性（交互作用P=0.157）；摘要未报告依从性关联的具体效应量和95%CI。
AI.conclusion: LCA可识别具有不同共病模式和不同不良结局风险的房颤临床表型。整合管理依从性与较好结局的关联在不同表型间无显著异质性，提示其可能适用于不同临床复杂程度的房颤患者。该研究为观察性分析，整合管理依从性的定义及具体效应量未在摘要中报告，仍需进一步研究验证并排除残余混杂。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）常与多种心血管（CV）和非CV合并症共存，这些合并症可能聚集形成具有不同结局意义的不同临床表型。

目的：我们旨在使用潜类别分析（LCA）识别AF中基于合并症的表型，描述其临床病程，并评估整合照护依从性与各表型结局之间的关联。

方法：基于11种疾病（CV和非CV）进行LCA。主要结局为全因死亡、血栓栓塞（TE）事件和急性冠脉综合征（ACS）的复合结局。次要结局为全因死亡以及ACS/TE事件。

结果：我们纳入1233例AF患者（中位年龄75[66-82]岁，女性37.5%）。识别出四种临床LCA衍生表型：“低合并症”（31.5%）；“心血管代谢型”（33.9%）；“老年合并症型”（22.9%）；以及“动脉粥样硬化-心力衰竭型”（11.8%）。在中位随访542天期间，234例患者（22.7%）发生主要结局。与“低合并症”相比，“心血管代谢型”（aHR 1.64，95% CI 1.13-2.39）、“老年合并症型”（aHR 1.62，95% CI 1.09-2.42）和“动脉粥样硬化-心力衰竭型”（aHR 2.81，95%CI 1.83-4.34）表型与主要结局风险升高独立相关。对整合照护的依从性在不同表型间存在差异，并与较低的不良事件风险相关，且无证据显示不同表型间存在显著异质性（p int=0.157）。

结论：潜类别分析识别出不同的AF临床表型，这些表型以特定的合并症模式为特征，并与不同的不良结局风险相关。整合照护与结局之间的关联在各表型间不存在显著异质性，这支持其在不同临床复杂程度的AF患者中具有潜在价值。

title: Stroke Risk-Based Anticoagulation After Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: ALONE-AF Post-Hoc Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Discontinuation of oral anticoagulant (OAC) in patients without recurrent atrial arrhythmia after ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) has been demonstrated to reduce composite outcomes of stroke, systemic embolism, and major bleeding compared with continued OAC.

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the optimal OAC strategy according to baseline stroke risk and AF recurrence.

METHODS: In this post-hoc analysis of the Long-Term Anticoagulation Discontinuation after Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation (ALONE-AF) trial, patients were stratified according to CHA2DS2-VASc score ≤2 and ≥3. Within each stratum, outcomes were compared between the OAC discontinuation and continuation subgroups. The cumulative incidence of stroke, systemic embolism, and major bleeding at 2 years was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method, with competing risk analysis accounting for AF recurrence.

RESULTS: Among 840 patients, 584 and 256 had a CHA2DS2-VASc score ≤2 (mean age 62.0±7.5 years, 15.9% female) and ≥3 (mean age 68.9±7.3 years, 45.3% female), respectively. In the CHA2DS2-VASc ≤2 stratum, the primary outcome occurred in one patient (0.4%) in discontinuation subgroup vs. six (2.4%) in continuation subgroup (absolute difference -1.9 percentage points, P=0.066). In the CHA2DS2-VASc ≥3 stratum, two events (1.8%) occurred in the continuation subgroup only (absolute difference -1.8 percentage points, P=0.172). All major bleeding events (n=5) occurred in the continuation subgroups. Competing risk analysis yielded consistent results.

CONCLUSIONS: In this exploratory post-hoc analysis, no statistically significant differences in outcomes were observed between OAC strategies when stratified by CHA2DS2-VASc score, though event numbers were limited. Larger prospective trials are needed to confirm these observations.

TRIAL REGISTRATIONS: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04432220.

AI.tldr: ALONE-AF事后分析显示，按CHA2DS2-VASc分层后，房颤消融后停用OAC与继续OAC在2年卒中/系统性栓塞/大出血复合终点上均无显著差异，但事件数有限。
AI.motivation: 房颤消融后无复发性房性心律失常的患者中，既往研究提示停用口服抗凝药（OAC）可降低卒中、系统性栓塞与大出血的复合结局，但如何根据基线卒中风险（CHA2DS2-VASc评分）和房颤复发情况选择最佳OAC策略尚不明确。
AI.method: 本研究为ALONE-AF试验（Long-Term Anticoagulation Discontinuation after Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation）的事后分析，共纳入840例患者，按CHA2DS2-VASc评分≤2分（584例）和≥3分（256例）分层，并在各层内比较停用OAC与继续OAC亚组。终点为2年卒中、系统性栓塞和大出血的累积发生率，采用Kaplan-Meier法估计，并以竞争风险分析校正房颤复发。
AI.result: CHA2DS2-VASc≤2分层中，主要终点在停用OAC组发生1例（0.4%），继续OAC组发生6例（2.4%），绝对差异-1.9个百分点，P=0.066。CHA2DS2-VASc≥3分层中，仅继续OAC组发生2例事件（1.8%），绝对差异-1.8个百分点，P=0.172。全部5例大出血事件均发生在继续OAC亚组。竞争风险分析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 这项探索性事后分析未发现按CHA2DS2-VASc评分分层后两种OAC策略的结局存在统计学显著差异，但事件数有限，尤其高危患者中停用OAC的安全性无法确认。所有大出血均见于继续OAC组，提示需更大规模前瞻性试验验证上述观察，并指导消融后基于卒中风险的个体化抗凝决策。

summary_zh:
背景：在因心房颤动（AF）接受消融治疗、且未复发房性心律失常的患者中，已有研究证实停用口服抗凝药（OAC）与继续服用OAC相比，可减少卒中、系统性栓塞和大出血的复合结局。

目的：本研究旨在依据基线卒中风险和AF复发情况，评估最佳的OAC策略。

方法：本分析为导管消融治疗心房颤动后长期停用抗凝治疗（ALONE-AF）试验的事后分析，患者按CHA2DS2-VASc评分≤2分和≥3分进行分层。在各层内，比较停用OAC亚组与继续OAC亚组的结局。采用Kaplan-Meier法估算2年时卒中、系统性栓塞和大出血的累积发生率，并以竞争风险分析处理AF复发。

结果：在840例患者中，CHA2DS2-VASc评分≤2分者584例（平均年龄62.0±7.5岁，女性15.9%），≥3分者256例（平均年龄68.9±7.3岁，女性45.3%）。在CHA2DS2-VASc≤2分层中，主要结局在停用OAC亚组中发生于1例患者（0.4%），而在继续OAC亚组中发生于6例（2.4%）（绝对差异-1.9个百分点，P=0.066）。在CHA2DS2-VASc≥3分层中，2例事件（1.8%）仅发生于继续OAC亚组（绝对差异-1.8个百分点，P=0.172）。所有大出血事件（n=5）均发生于继续OAC亚组。竞争风险分析结果一致。

结论：在这项探索性事后分析中，按CHA2DS2-VASc评分分层时，未观察到不同OAC策略之间结局存在统计学显著差异，但事件数量有限。需要更大规模的前瞻性试验来证实这些观察结果。

试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT04432220。

title: Steatotic liver disease phenotypes and stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation: A nationwide population-based cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The updated nomenclature of steatotic liver disease (SLD) recognizes distinct phenotypes, including Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), MASLD with increased alcohol intake (MetALD), and alcohol-related liver disease (ALD). Although cardiovascular risk may differ across SLD phenotypes, their association with stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) remains unclear.

OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate the association between SLD phenotypes and ischemic stroke risk in AF patients.

METHODS: AF patients diagnosed between 2010 and 2018 were identified from the Korean health insurance database. According to SLD phenotype, patients were categorized into No-SLD, MASLD, MetALD, and ALD. The primary outcome was ischemic stroke. Subgroup analyses were conducted by CHA2DS2-VA score.

RESULTS: Among 196,242 patients (No-SLD: 101,308; MASLD: 77,715; MetALD: 8,678; ALD: 8,541), median follow-up was 5.9 years. Compared with No-SLD, MASLD was not associated with stroke risk (adjusted hazard ratio and 95% confidence interval; 1.00, 0.97-1.04), whereas MetALD and ALD were associated with higher risk (1.09, 1.00-1.18 and 1.16, 1.08-1.26, respectively). In exploratory subgroup analyses, the higher risk associated with alcohol-related phenotypes appeared more apparent at lower CHA2DS2-VA scores; however, the 6-year absolute risk differences were approximately 1% or less, and these findings are regarded as hypothesis-generating.

CONCLUSION: In patients with AF, stroke risk was significantly higher in the alcohol-related SLD phenotypes, MetALD and ALD, whereas MASLD was not associated with stroke risk. These findings are consistent with the current recommendations for comprehensive risk-factor management in AF, with particular attention to alcohol intake in patients with alcohol-related SLD phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 韩国全国性队列显示，在 AF 患者中，酒精相关脂肪性肝病表型（MetALD、ALD）与缺血性卒中风险升高相关（aHR 分别为 1.09 和 1.16），而单纯 MASLD 与卒中风险无关（aHR 1.00）。
AI.motivation: 脂肪性肝病（SLD）新命名将患者区分为 MASLD、MetALD 与 ALD 等表型，不同表型的心血管风险可能存在差异；但各 SLD 表型与 AF 患者缺血性卒中风险的关系尚不明确，既往研究多未区分酒精摄入因素，缺乏大样本人群证据。
AI.method: 基于韩国健康保险数据库的全国性人群队列研究，纳入 2010—2018 年确诊的 AF 患者共 196,242 例，按 SLD 表型分为无 SLD（101,308 例）、MASLD（77,715 例）、MetALD（8,678 例）和 ALD（8,541 例）。主要终点为缺血性卒中，中位随访 5.9 年；采用校正后 Cox 风险比（aHR）及 95%CI 评估关联，并按 CHA2DS2-VA 评分进行亚组分析。
AI.result: 与无 SLD 相比，MASLD 与卒中风险无关（aHR 1.00，95%CI 0.97–1.04）；MetALD（aHR 1.09，95%CI 1.00–1.18）与 ALD（aHR 1.16，95%CI 1.08–1.26）卒中风险显著升高。探索性亚组分析中，酒精相关表型的风险升高在 CHA2DS2-VA 评分较低者中似更明显，但 6 年绝对风险差约 ≤1%，属假设生成性质。
AI.conclusion: 在 AF 患者中，酒精相关 SLD 表型（MetALD、ALD）与缺血性卒中风险升高相关，而 MASLD 与卒中风险无关，支持当前 AF 综合危险因素管理的推荐，尤其应关注酒精相关 SLD 表型患者的饮酒情况。该研究为观察性设计，残余混杂与 ICD 编码定义的暴露可能影响结果，绝对风险差异较小，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：更新后的脂肪性肝病（steatotic liver disease，SLD）命名体系识别出不同的表型，包括代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）、伴酒精摄入量增加的MASLD（MetALD）以及酒精相关性肝病（ALD）。尽管不同SLD表型的心血管风险可能存在差异，但其与心房颤动（AF）患者卒中风险之间的关系仍不明确。

目的：本研究旨在探讨AF患者中SLD表型与缺血性卒中风险之间的关系。

方法：从韩国健康保险数据库中筛选出2010年至2018年间诊断为AF的患者。根据SLD表型，将患者分为无SLD（No-SLD）、MASLD、MetALD和ALD四组。主要结局为缺血性卒中。按CHA2DS2-VA评分进行亚组分析。

结果：共纳入196,242例患者（No-SLD：101,308例；MASLD：77,715例；MetALD：8,678例；ALD：8,541例），中位随访时间为5.9年。与No-SLD相比，MASLD与卒中风险无关（校正风险比及95%置信区间为1.00，0.97-1.04），而MetALD和ALD与更高的风险相关（分别为1.09，1.00-1.18和1.16，1.08-1.26）。在探索性亚组分析中，酒精相关表型所伴随的较高风险在CHA2DS2-VA评分较低时似乎更为明显；然而，6年绝对风险差异约为1%或更低，且这些结果被视为假设生成性发现。

结论：在AF患者中，酒精相关的SLD表型MetALD和ALD的卒中风险显著升高，而MASLD与卒中风险无关。这些发现与当前关于AF综合危险因素管理的建议相一致，尤其应关注酒精相关SLD表型患者的酒精摄入。

title: Association of Air Pollution Exposure and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation: The Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Consistent evidence indicates that air pollution negatively impacts cardiovascular health. However, the relationship between air pollution and atrial fibrillation (AF) is unclear, and exposure measurement error has been a significant concern for prior studies.

OBJECTIVE: This prospective cohort study aimed to evaluate the association of chronic air pollution exposure and risk of AF.

METHODS: We used data from the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis, a community-based cohort study conducted in 6 U.S. metropolitan areas. Concentrations of 4 pollutants (PM2.5, NO2, NOx, and O3) were assessed from 2000-2018 using hierarchical spatiotemporal models that incorporated cohort-specific monitoring to estimate ambient exposure at participants' residences. In Cox regression models, pollution estimates were represented as time-varying exposures, with 2-year rolling averages updated every 30 days. In our primary model, we adjusted for demographics and health behaviors.

RESULTS: Our study included 6618 participants (mean age 62; 53% female). Over 16.5 years median follow-up, we identified 1055 AF events. In our primary model, an interquartile range increment of NO2 (13.5 ppb) was associated with 29% higher risk of AF (hazard ratio 95% CI: 1.00, 1.67). Associations with PM2.5, NOx, and O3 were weaker but also directionally consistent with higher risk.

CONCLUSION: We found evidence linking air pollution exposure to risk of incident AF. These results can be used to inform policy and other public health efforts aimed at alleviating the burden of AF, especially given that NO2 exposure estimates (median 17.3 ppb) fell well below the current U.S. Environmental Protection Agency annual standard of 53 ppb.

AI.tldr: MESA 多族裔队列 6618 名成人随访 16.5 年，NO2 每升高一个四分位间距（13.5 ppb），新发房颤风险增加 29%（HR 1.29，95%CI 1.00–1.67），PM2.5、NOx、O3 关联方向一致但较弱。
AI.motivation: 既往证据一致提示空气污染损害心血管健康，但其与房颤的关系尚不明确。既有研究的主要缺陷在于暴露测量误差：多采用粗分辨率或单一时点、固定住址的暴露估计，缺乏结合队列特异性监测的精细时空模型，也无法反映暴露的时间变化。本研究拟在社区人群中检验长期空气污染暴露与新发房颤的关联。
AI.method: 前瞻性社区队列研究，数据来自美国 6 个大都市区开展的多族裔动脉粥样硬化研究（MESA），共纳入 6618 名参与者（平均年龄 62 岁，53% 女性）。暴露为 PM2.5、NO2、NOx、O3 四种污染物，2000–2018 年通过分层时空模型并结合队列特异性监测，估算参与者居住地的环境浓度；在 Cox 回归中按时变暴露处理，采用每 30 天更新的 2 年滚动平均值。主要终点为新发房颤事件。主模型校正人口学特征与健康行为，摘要未报告更多协变量、竞争风险处理及敏感性分析细节。
AI.result: 中位随访 16.5 年，共记录 1055 例新发房颤。主模型中，NO2 每升高一个四分位间距（13.5 ppb）与新发房颤风险增加 29% 相关（HR 1.29，95%CI 1.00–1.67），置信区间下限为 1.00。PM2.5、NOx 与 O3 的效应较弱，但方向一致，均指向风险升高；摘要未报告这三种污染物的具体效应量与 P 值。NO2 暴露中位数为 17.3 ppb，远低于美国环保署（EPA）现行年均标准 53 ppb。亚组分析、其他污染物效应估计及敏感性分析结果摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 长期空气污染暴露，尤其 NO2，与新发房颤风险升高相关，且关联出现的暴露水平远低于美国现行监管限值，提示现有空气质量标准可能不足以保护心律健康，可为民航政策与公共卫生干预提供依据。局限性包括：观察性设计难以排除残余混杂（如交通噪声、社会经济因素）；NO2 效应置信区间下限恰为 1.00，统计稳健性有限；暴露为居住地模型估算而非个体监测；房颤事件依赖队列随访判定，可能漏诊无症状或阵发性房颤，且未报告植入式心电监测等节律监测手段。

目的：本前瞻性队列研究旨在评估长期空气污染暴露与AF风险的关联。

title: Unipolar Electrograms at the Pulmonary Vein Antrum: Spatial and Directional Heterogeneity with Distinct Postablation Morphologies.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Disappearance of the near-field S-wave in the unipolar electrogram (U-EGM) is commonly used to assess lesion formation during pulmonary vein (PV) isolation; however, interpretation of U-EGMs in anatomically complex atrial regions remains uncertain.

OBJECTIVE: We aimed to characterize spatial, directional, and postablation changes in antral PV U-EGMs, and evaluate the limitations of conventional waveform interpretation.

METHODS: In 15 patients undergoing radiofrequency ablation for atrial fibrillation, U-EGMs were recorded at 116 antral PV sites during sinus rhythm and distal coronary sinus (CS) pacing before and after ablation. U-EGM morphology and R- and S-wave amplitudes were analyzed.

RESULTS: Baseline U-EGMs showed spatial heterogeneity, with a small r and deep S in the right anterior PV antrum transitioning to a positive-dominant morphology (Rs) in the left-lower PV antra. Distal CS pacing altered the activation sequence, causing direction-dependent changes, most prominently in the right PV antrum. After ablation, overall S-wave amplitude decreased from -0.94 ± 0.70 to -0.08 ± 0.55 mV (P<0.001). Residual negative deflections ≥0.5 mV persisted in 18.1% (21/116) of recordings, frequently in association with direction-dependent far-field activity. Newly developed positive deflections ≥1.0 mV were observed in 17/116 sites (14.7%; mean 1.42 ± 0.42 mV), predominantly in the right-sided antra.

CONCLUSIONS: Antral PV U-EGMs frequently represent composites of near- and far-field signals with spatial heterogeneity and direction-dependent variation. Postablation responses are diverse, including S-wave disappearance, residual negativity, often reflecting contributions from overlapping far-field components, and newly developed positive deflections. PV-antral U-EGMs should be interpreted in the context of their composite nature.

title: Characteristics of patients with obesity presenting with cardiac arrest and the potential role of cardioverter-defibrillator therapy: an analysis using the National Inpatient Sample database.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Obesity is a well established risk factor for cardiovascular disease and has been associated with an increased incidence of cardiac arrest. This study utilizes the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) database to analyze the characteristics of obese patients presenting with cardiac arrest and explores the potential role of implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) therapy in this population.

METHODS: We analyzed data from the NIS database between 2016 and 2020, including obese (body mass index ≥30) adult patients with and without cardiac arrest. Baseline characteristics and comorbidities were identified using relevant ICD-10 codes. Differences in outcomes and comorbidities between the two groups, as well as factors associated with ICD placement, were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression.

RESULTS: We analyzed 4 445 524 obese patients, including 88 770 individuals who presented with cardiac arrest (mean age: 63.2 ± 12.6 years) and 4 356 754 without cardiac arrest (mean age: 59.0 ± 15.2 years). Obese patients with cardiac arrest were more likely to be White men with a greater burden of comorbidities, such as hypertension, chronic ischemic heart disease, smoking, alcohol use, hyperthyroidism, congestive heart failure, and atrial and ventricular arrhythmias, with atrial fibrillation being a particularly dominant association with cardiac arrest (odds ratio: 7.80, P < 0.001). In addition, individuals with private insurance and those treated at large, urban teaching hospitals were more likely to be diagnosed with cardiac arrest, with longer hospital stays, higher costs, and increased mortality. In the setting of cardiac arrest associated with ventricular tachycardia and fibrillation, males with private insurance, higher median household incomes (> $35 000), and treatment at large, urban teaching hospitals had higher odds of ICD placement. Furthermore, obese individuals with advancing age and comorbidities - including diabetes, obstructive lung disease, peripheral vascular disease, and renal and liver disease - faced higher odds of mortality without an ICD. Compared with White patients, Asian, Pacific Islander, and Native American individuals without an ICD also had higher odds of mortality.

CONCLUSION: Obese individuals, particularly White males with comorbidities, were more likely to experience cardiac arrest, with atrial fibrillation being a strong independent risk factor even after adjustment for heart failure. Disparities in healthcare access were evident, with individuals of higher socioeconomic status more likely to receive ICDs, while certain racial groups had worse outcomes.

AI.tldr: 基于美国NIS 2016–2020年445万例肥胖住院患者，其中8.9万例发生心脏骤停；房颤与心脏骤停独立强相关（OR 7.80），白人男性及合并症负担重者风险更高，而ICD植入明显受社会经济地位与种族因素影响。

结论：肥胖个体，尤其是合并症的白人男性，更可能发生心脏骤停，其中房颤即使在对心力衰竭进行调整后仍是一个强的独立危险因素。医疗可及性方面的差异显而易见，社会经济地位较高的个体更可能接受ICD，而某些种族群体的结局更差。

title: Hemodynamic and Metabolic Predictors of Unsuccessful Electrical Cardioversion or Early Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Electrical Cardioversion.
summary: Background: Rhythm control remains a cornerstone in the management of atrial fibrillation (AF). Although electrical cardioversion (ECV) effectively restores sinus rhythm (SR), its short-term durability is limited. Aims: This study aimed to evaluate the short-term rhythm outcomes after ECV and to identify predictors of failure to achieve or maintain SR within 30 days after ECV, with particular emphasis on the hemodynamic profile of patients with persistent AF. Methods: Ninety-four consecutive patients with persistent AF undergoing elective ECV were prospectively enrolled. Cardiac rhythm was assessed immediately after ECV, at ~24 h, and ~30 days. Laboratory testing, echocardiography, and impedance cardiography (ICG) were performed before ECV. Logistic regression analysis was used to identify predictors of failure to achieve or maintain SR within 30 days after ECV. Results: ECV was initially successful in 80 patients (85.1%), with SR maintained in 76 (80.8%) at 24 h. At 30 days, SR persisted in 49 patients (52.1%), while 43 patients (45.7%) failed to achieve or maintain SR, including 14 patients in whom ECV was unsuccessful and 29 patients who experienced AF recurrence after initially successful ECV; two patients were lost to follow-up. In multivariable analysis, T2DM was independently associated with higher odds of failure to achieve or maintain SR within 30 days after ECV (OR 3.26; 95% CI 1.183-8.978; p = 0.022). Higher TFC values were also independently associated with increased odds of this outcome (OR 1.15; 95% CI 1.017-1.291; p = 0.025). In contrast, the presence of hypertension was associated with lower odds of this outcome (OR 0.30; 95% CI 0.094-0.947; p = 0.040). Among hemodynamic parameters, only TFC was independently associated with the outcome, whereas echocardiographic parameters did not differ between groups. Conclusions: Even in a relatively low-risk population without advanced comorbidity burden, failure to achieve or maintain SR after ECV remains frequent. T2DM and elevated TFC were independently associated with failure to achieve or maintain SR, while hypertension was associated with a lower risk. These findings suggest that metabolic and hemodynamic abnormalities may provide prognostic information beyond that captured by conventional echocardiography.

AI.tldr: 在94例持续性房颤择期电复律患者中，30天窦律维持率仅52.1%；T2DM与阻抗心动图TFC升高独立预测复律失败或早期复发，而高血压与较低风险相关。
AI.motivation: 节律控制是房颤管理基石，电复律虽能有效恢复窦律，但短期维持效果有限。既往对电复律失败及30天内早期复发的预测因素认识不足，尤其持续性房颤患者血流动力学指标（如阻抗心动图参数）的预后价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 前瞻性研究纳入94例连续接受择期电复律的持续性房颤患者。复律后即刻、约24小时及约30天评估心律；复律前完成实验室检查、超声心动图及阻抗心动图（ICG）。主要终点为电复律后30天内未能恢复或维持窦律。采用logistic回归分析识别预测因素。
AI.result: 电复律即刻成功率85.1%（80/94），24小时窦律维持80.8%（76/94）；30天窦律维持52.1%（49/94），45.7%（43/94）未达到或未维持窦律（14例复律失败、29例早期复发），2例失访。多变量分析中，T2DM（OR 3.26；95%CI 1.183–8.978；P=0.022）和较高TFC（胸腔液体含量；OR 1.15；95%CI 1.017–1.291；P=0.025）独立增加终点风险；高血压与较低风险相关（OR 0.30；95%CI 0.094–0.947；P=0.040）。血流动力学指标中仅TFC独立相关，超声心动图参数组间无差异。
AI.conclusion: 即使在合并症负担较轻的相对低危人群，电复律后30天内恢复并维持窦律的比例仍不高。T2DM和TFC升高提示代谢及血流动力学异常，可能提供超越常规超声心动图的预后信息；高血压与较低风险相关。研究样本量小、事件数有限且缺乏外部验证，TFC阈值及机制尚需进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：节律控制仍然是心房颤动（AF）管理的基石。尽管电复律（ECV）能有效恢复窦性心律（SR），但其短期持久性有限。

目的：本研究旨在评估ECV后的短期节律结局，并识别ECV后30天内未能达到或维持SR的预测因素，特别关注持续性AF患者的血流动力学特征。

方法：前瞻性纳入94例接受择期ECV的持续性AF连续患者。在ECV后即刻、约24 h和约30天评估心律。ECV前进行实验室检查、超声心动图和阻抗心动图（ICG）。采用logistic回归分析识别ECV后30天内未能达到或维持SR的预测因素。

结果：ECV最初在80例患者（85.1%）中成功，24 h时76例（80.8%）维持SR。30天时，49例患者（52.1%）仍维持SR，而43例患者（45.7%）未能达到或维持SR，包括14例ECV未成功者和29例在ECV最初成功后发生AF复发者；2例失访。在多变量分析中，T2DM与ECV后30天内未能达到或维持SR的更高几率独立相关（OR 3.26；95% CI 1.183-8.978；p = 0.022）。较高的TFC值也与该结局的几率增加独立相关（OR 1.15；95% CI 1.017-1.291；p = 0.025）。相反，合并高血压与该结局的较低几率相关（OR 0.30；95% CI 0.094-0.947；p = 0.040）。在血流动力学参数中，仅TFC与结局独立相关，而超声心动图参数在各组间无差异。

结论：即使在无晚期合并症负担的相对低危人群中，ECV后未能达到或维持SR仍较常见。T2DM和TFC升高与未能达到或维持SR独立相关，而高血压与较低风险相关。这些发现提示，代谢和血流动力学异常可能提供超出常规超声心动图所捕获信息的预后信息。

title: Evaluation of Intraprocedural Strategies to Assess Acute Pulmonary Vein Isolation After First-Pass Wide Antral Circumferential Ablation.
summary: Background: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia. While pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) remains the cornerstone of AF ablation, the optimal method for confirming complete acute isolation remains uncertain. This study evaluated the diagnostic value of pulmonary vein (PV) pacing compared with repeat three-dimensional (3D) electroanatomical mapping following wide antral circumferential ablation (WACA). Methods: In this prospective observational study, 58 patients with paroxysmal or persistent AF undergoing bilateral WACA at the University Heart Center Ulm between November 2023 and April 2025 were included. Following successful PVI, pacing was performed from each PV and the corresponding carina region using a maximal stimulation output of 20 mA. Subsequently, comprehensive 3D re-mapping was performed to reassess electrical conduction. Results obtained from pacing maneuvers were compared with repeat mapping findings. Results: The study population had a median age of 73 (62.7-78.2) years and a median body mass index of 26.8 (24.0-29.9) kg/m2. Median left atrial diameter was 4.8 (4.3-5.5) cm, and moderate to advanced atrial fibrosis was present in approximately one-third of patients. For the left-sided PVs, pacing assessment alone was associated with a significantly higher proportion of false-negative results compared with 3D re-mapping (left upper PV: p = 0.039; left inferior PV: p = 0.012). In contrast, no significant differences were observed for the right PVs. Evaluation of the carina regions showed a similar pattern, with a significant discrepancy on the left side (p = 0.002) but not on the right side (p = 0.453). Conclusions: PV pacing alone may not reliably identify residual conduction within the left PVs and left carina after WACA. Additional 3D re-mapping appears valuable in these regions to detect persistent conduction gaps that could otherwise remain unnoticed. For right-sided PVs, pacing-based assessment may provide sufficient confirmation of acute isolation in many cases. These findings support a complementary use of both techniques to improve procedural verification of PVI. Larger prospective studies are warranted to confirm the observed results and determine their clinical implications.

AI.tldr: 在 58 例接受双侧广域环肺静脉消融的 AF 患者中，单用肺静脉起搏评估急性隔离在左侧肺静脉及左嵴部假阴性率显著高于三维电解剖再标测（LSPV p=0.039、LIPV p=0.012、左嵴 p=0.002），右侧则无差异。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离（PVI）是 AF 消融的基石，但 WACA 后如何可靠确认急性完全隔离尚无统一标准。起搏法操作简便，三维电解剖再标测更全面但耗时；既往缺乏在同一组患者中直接比较两种方法、并按左/右肺静脉及嵴部分层评估诊断价值的前瞻性数据，可能导致残余传导漏判与复发风险被低估。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入 2023 年 11 月至 2025 年 4 月于 Ulm 大学心脏中心接受双侧 WACA 的阵发性或持续性 AF 患者 58 例。完成 PVI 后依次行两种评估：(1) 自每支肺静脉及对应嵴部起搏，最大输出 20 mA；(2) 全面三维电解剖再标测复评电传导。以再标测结果为参照，比较起搏法的诊断表现（假阴性等），按左上下肺静脉、右上下肺静脉及左/右嵴部分层进行统计学比较。摘要未报告具体统计检验方法、效应量与置信区间。
AI.result: 人群的中位年龄为 73（62.7–78.2）岁，BMI 为 26.8（24.0–29.9）kg/m²，左房内径 4.8（4.3–5.5）cm，约三分之一患者存在中度至重度心房纤维化。左侧肺静脉：起搏评估的假阴性比例显著高于三维再标测（左上肺静脉 p=0.039，左下肺静脉 p=0.012）；右侧肺静脉两种方法差异无统计学意义。嵴部结果呈相同侧别模式：左侧差异显著（p=0.002），右侧无差异（p=0.453）。各比较的具体假阴性率、率差及 95% CI 摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: WACA 后单用肺静脉起搏可能无法可靠识别左侧肺静脉与左嵴部的残余传导，建议这些区域补充三维电解剖再标测以发现可能被漏掉的传导间隙；右侧肺静脉起搏评估在多数病例中或已足以确认急性隔离。研究提示两种技术互补使用可提高 PVI 术中验证的可靠性。局限性包括单中心、样本量小（58 例）、观察性设计、缺乏临床终点（如房性心律失常复发）随访；作者呼吁更大规模前瞻性研究验证并明确其临床意义。

summary_zh:
背景：房颤（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常。尽管肺静脉隔离（PVI）仍是房颤消融的基石，但确认急性完全隔离的最佳方法仍不确定。本研究评估了在宽大前庭环周消融（WACA）后，肺静脉（PV）起搏与重复三维（3D）电解剖标测相比的诊断价值。

方法：在这项前瞻性观察性研究中，纳入了2023年11月至2025年4月期间在乌尔姆大学心脏中心接受双侧WACA的58例阵发性或持续性房颤患者。在成功完成PVI后，使用最大刺激输出20 mA从每支肺静脉及相应肺静脉嵴部区域进行起搏。随后进行全面的3D重新标测以重新评估电传导。将起搏操作获得的结果与重复标测结果进行比较。

结果：研究人群的中位年龄为73（62.7-78.2）岁，中位体重指数为26.8（24.0-29.9）kg/m2。中位左心房直径为4.8（4.3-5.5）cm，约三分之一患者存在中度至重度心房纤维化。对于左侧肺静脉，与3D重新标测相比，仅采用起搏评估与显著更高比例的假阴性结果相关（左上肺静脉：p = 0.039；左下肺静脉：p = 0.012）。相反，右侧肺静脉未观察到显著差异。对嵴部区域的评估显示出相似模式，左侧存在显著差异（p = 0.002），而右侧无显著差异（p = 0.453）。

结论：仅依靠肺静脉起搏可能无法可靠识别WACA后左侧肺静脉及左侧肺静脉嵴部内的残余传导。在这些区域，额外的3D重新标测似乎有价值，可检测否则可能被遗漏的持续性传导间隙。对于右侧肺静脉，基于起搏的评估在许多情况下可能足以确认急性隔离。这些发现支持两种技术的互补使用，以改善PVI的术中验证。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来证实观察到的结果并确定其临床意义。

title: Thromboembolic and Mortality Risk in Patients with Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft-The TRIP-AF Study.
summary: Background/Objectives: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is a common complication of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and may recur during cardiac rehabilitation (CR); its long-term prognostic value remains unclear. We evaluated the impact of POAF on a composite endpoint of all-cause mortality and non-fatal stroke after isolated CABG and assessed POAF duration and timing, AF recurrence, and other predictors of adverse outcomes. Methods: This multicentre retrospective study enrolled 1139 patients who underwent CR after isolated CABG between 2011 and 2015 across 17 Italian centres. Clinical and outcome data were obtained from medical records and structured interviews; median follow-up was 5.78 years. Results: POAF occurred in 34.3% of patients and was associated with a higher incidence of the primary composite endpoint of all-cause mortality and non-fatal stroke in univariate analysis (15.4% vs. 10.0%, p = 0.008), particularly when lasting ≥48 h or occurring during both surgery and rehabilitation. However, in multivariate analysis POAF was not an independent predictor; instead, CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥3, reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, elevated urea, history of heart failure, and AF recurrence during follow-up predicted adverse outcomes. Conclusions: POAF reflects early vulnerability but does not independently predict long-term mortality or stroke. Conversely, AF recurrence and CHA2DS2-VASc score retain strong prognostic value, underscoring the need for long-term rhythm monitoring and individualised risk assessment post-CABG.

AI.tldr: 在接受单纯 CABG 后参加心脏康复的多中心队列中，术后房颤发生率 34.3%，单因素分析显示其与全因死亡合并非致死性卒中的复合终点相关，但多因素分析显示其并非独立预测因素。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤（POAF）是冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后的常见并发症，并可能在心脏康复（CR）期间复发，但其对远期预后的独立影响尚不明确。既往证据对 POAF 持续时间、发生时机（术中与康复期）以及随访期房颤复发与不良结局的关系缺乏系统评估，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: TRIP-AF 为多中心回顾性研究，纳入 2011—2015 年意大利 17 家中心接受单纯 CABG 后进入心脏康复的患者共 1139 例。临床与结局数据来自病历及结构化访谈，中位随访 5.78 年。主要终点为全因死亡与非致死性卒中的复合终点；同时评估 POAF 持续时间与发生时机、随访期房颤复发及其他不良结局预测因素。统计方法包括单因素与多因素分析（摘要未报告具体模型与校正变量细节）。
AI.result: POAF 发生率为 34.3%。单因素分析中，POAF 组主要复合终点发生率显著更高（15.4% vs. 10.0%，p=0.008），尤其见于 POAF 持续≥48 h 或于外科手术期与康复期均发生者。多因素分析中 POAF 并非独立预测因素；独立预测因素为 CHA2DS2-VASc 评分≥3、左心室射血分数降低、尿素升高、心力衰竭病史及随访期间房颤复发。摘要未报告各独立预测因素的效应量、95%CI 及具体 P 值。
AI.conclusion: POAF 更多反映 CABG 围术期的早期易损状态，而非远期死亡或卒中的独立预测因素；随访期房颤复发与 CHA2DS2-VASc 评分仍具较强预后价值。这提示 CABG 术后应加强长期节律监测并对高危患者进行个体化风险评估，而非仅依据 POAF 本身决定长期抗凝策略。局限性包括回顾性设计、POAF 监测方式与强度不统一、随访依赖病历与访谈可能低估无症状房颤复发，且摘要未报告多因素模型的效应量。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：术后心房颤动（POAF）是冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）的常见并发症，并可能在心脏康复（CR）期间复发；其长期预后价值尚不明确。我们评估了POAF对单纯CABG术后全因死亡与非致死性卒中的复合终点的影响，并评估了POAF的持续时间与发生时机、AF复发以及其他不良结局预测因素。方法：这项多中心回顾性研究纳入了2011年至2015年间在意大利17个中心接受单纯CABG后行CR的1139例患者。临床与结局数据来自病历和结构化访谈；中位随访时间为5.78年。结果：34.3%的患者发生POAF，在单变量分析中，POAF与全因死亡和非致死性卒中这一主要复合终点的发生率较高相关（15.4% vs. 10.0%，p = 0.008），尤其是当POAF持续≥48 h或在手术期间和康复期间均发生时。然而，在多变量分析中，POAF并非独立预测因素；相反，CHA2DS2-VASc评分≥3、左心室射血分数降低、尿素升高、心力衰竭病史以及随访期间AF复发可预测不良结局。结论：POAF反映了早期易感性，但不能独立预测长期死亡率或卒中。相反，AF复发和CHA2DS2-VASc评分仍具有强大的预后价值，这凸显了CABG术后进行长期心律监测和个体化风险评估的必要性。

title: Association Between Left Atrial Enlargement and Atrial Fibrillation in Elderly Patients with Left Ventricular Diastolic Dysfunction.
summary: Background: Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (LVDD) is associated with chronically elevated left ventricular filling pressures that promote left atrial (LA) remodeling and increase the risk of atrial fibrillation (AF). Because AF is frequently asymptomatic during its early stages, identifying echocardiographic markers that facilitate early risk stratification is of considerable clinical importance. This study investigated the association between LA enlargement and AF in elderly patients with LVDD using conventional echocardiographic LA size parameters. Methods: This prospective observational study enrolled 100 consecutive patients aged ≥ 60 years with echocardiographically confirmed LVDD and no documented history of AF between December 2023 and May 2024. Comprehensive transthoracic echocardiography was performed to assess LA diameter, biplane LA volume using Simpson's method, LA volume by the area-length method, and indexed LA volume (LAVI). The presence of AF was determined by standard 12-lead electrocardiography and rhythm assessment. Echocardiographic parameters were compared between patients with and without AF using appropriate statistical analyses. Results: The study population had a mean age of 68.37 ± 6.31 years, and 52% were male. AF was identified in 15% of participants, while mild LA enlargement was observed in 18%. Among patients with LA enlargement, 72.2% had AF compared with only 2.4% of patients with a normal LA size (p < 0.001). Patients with AF demonstrated significantly greater biplane LA volume (69.10 ± 9.61 vs. 52.21 ± 6.28 mL), LA volume measured by the area-length method (71.42 ± 9.51 vs. 54.03 ± 6.53 mL), and indexed LA volume (37.33 ± 3.81 vs. 28.87 ± 3.65 mL/m2) than those without AF (all p < 0.001). Conclusions: Left atrial enlargement measured using echocardiographic assessment, particularly indexed LA volume, is strongly associated with atrial fibrillation in elderly patients with left ventricular diastolic dysfunction.

AI.tldr: 在100例≥60岁、超声证实左室舒张功能障碍且无房颤病史的患者中，15%检出房颤；左房增大者房颤比例高达72.2%，而左房正常者仅2.4%，以左房容积指数差异最显著。
AI.motivation: 左室舒张功能障碍（LVDD）导致左室充盈压长期升高，促进左房重构并增加房颤（AF）风险；而 AF 早期常无症状，因此寻找可用于早期风险分层的超声心动图标志物具有重要临床价值。既往关于常规超声左房大小参数（尤其是左房容积指数）在老年 LVDD 人群中与 AF 关联的数据仍不充分。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，2023年12月至2024年5月连续纳入100例年龄≥60岁、经超声心动图证实 LVDD 且无 AF 病史的患者。全部行经胸超声心动图，测量左房内径、Simpson 法双平面左房容积、面积-长度法左房容积及体表面积标化的左房容积指数（LAVI）。AF 通过标准12导联心电图及节律评估判定。比较有无 AF 两组间超声参数的差异；摘要未报告具体统计方法、多因素校正模型及效应量（OR/HR）。
AI.result: 人群平均年龄68.37±6.31岁，男性占52%。AF 检出率为15%，轻度左房增大者占18%。左房增大患者中72.2%存在 AF，而左房大小正常者仅2.4%（p<0.001）。AF 组的双平面左房容积（69.10±9.61 vs 52.21±6.28 mL）、面积-长度法左房容积（71.42±9.51 vs 54.03±6.53 mL）及 LAVI（37.33±3.81 vs 28.87±3.65 mL/m²）均显著大于无 AF 组（均为 p<0.001）。摘要未报告两组间左房内径的具体数值，亦未报告校正后效应量与95%置信区间。

背景：左心室舒张功能障碍（LVDD）与左心室充盈压长期升高有关，后者会促进左心房（LA）重构并增加心房颤动（AF）的风险。由于AF在早期阶段常无症状，因此识别有助于早期风险分层的超声心动图标志物具有重要的临床意义。本研究采用常规超声心动图左心房大小参数，探讨合并LVDD的老年患者中左心房扩大与AF之间的关联。

方法：本前瞻性观察性研究于2023年12月至2024年5月连续纳入100例年龄≥60岁、经超声心动图确诊LVDD且无AF病史记录的患者。所有患者均接受全面的经胸超声心动图检查，以评估左心房内径、采用Simpson法测定的双平面左心房容积、采用面积-长度法测定的左心房容积以及左心房容积指数（LAVI）。通过标准12导联心电图和心律评估确定是否存在AF。采用适当的统计学分析比较伴AF与不伴AF患者的超声心动图参数。

结果：研究人群的平均年龄为68.37 ± 6.31岁，52%为男性。15%的受试者检出AF，18%的受试者观察到轻度左心房扩大。在左心房扩大的患者中，72.2%合并AF，而左心房大小正常的患者中仅为2.4%（p < 0.001）。与不伴AF的患者相比，伴AF患者的双平面左心房容积（69.10 ± 9.61 vs. 52.21 ± 6.28 mL）、面积-长度法测定的左心房容积（71.42 ± 9.51 vs. 54.03 ± 6.53 mL）以及左心房容积指数（37.33 ± 3.81 vs. 28.87 ± 3.65 mL/m2）均显著更大（均p < 0.001）。

结论：通过超声心动图评估测定的左心房扩大，尤其是左心房容积指数，与合并左心室舒张功能障碍的老年患者的心房颤动密切相关。

title: Pressure-Waveform Guidance for Pulmonary Vein Occlusion During Cryoballoon Ablation: Procedural Efficiency and Repeat-Procedure Findings from a Large Single-Center Cohort.
summary: Background/Objectives: The cryoballoon (CB) has simplified pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) for treating atrial fibrillation (AF). Vein occlusion is usually assessed utilizing contrast media which entails possible risks and increases fluoroscopy exposure. Pressure-guided assessment of occlusion has emerged as a potential alternative. The objective of this study is to compare procedural characteristics and repeat-procedure findings of pressure-guided and contrast-guided assessment of vein occlusion. Methods: From July 2018 to December 2023, 1166 patients (485 [41%] female, mean age 65 ± 10 years) with AF (64% paroxysmal) undergoing CB-PVI were enrolled at a single-center, 368 (32%) underwent a contrast-guided and 798 (68%) a pressure-guided approach. Results: Procedure duration (90 ± 20 vs. 93 ± 23 min) and ablation time (1342 ± 361 vs. 1368 ± 406 s) were similar in pressure- and contrast- guided groups, and the acute success rate of PVI was high in both groups. The pressure-guided approach had shorter X-ray times (5.7 ± 3.4 vs. 9.5 ± 4.8 min, p < 0.0001) and lower X-ray doses (82 ± 78.9 vs. 586 ± 546 cGy/cm2, p < 0.0001). In 112 redo-procedures for arrhythmia recurrence after CB-PVI, durable isolation of all veins was observed more often after pressure-guided procedures (28/56 [50%] vs. 13/56 [23%]); per-vein durability was also higher (174/224 [78%] vs. 150/224 [67%], p = 0.015). Conclusions: Pressure-waveform guidance during CB-PVI is a feasible alternative to contrast-guided occlusion assessment and was associated with substantially lower intraprocedural fluoroscopy exposure. Repeat-procedure findings suggest a possible durability signal, but this observation should be considered exploratory and confirmed in prospective studies.

AI.result: 压力指导组与造影指导组手术时长（90±20 vs 93±23 min）和消融时间（1342±361 vs 1368±406 s）相近，急性PVI成功率两组均高（摘要未报告具体数值）。压力指导组X线透视时间更短（5.7±3.4 vs 9.5±4.8 min，p<0.0001），X线剂量更低（82±78.9 vs 586±546 cGy/cm²，p<0.0001）。112例再手术中，压力指导后全部静脉持久隔离更常见（28/56[50%] vs 13/56[23%]）；按静脉计算的持久隔离率亦更高（174/224[78%] vs 150/224[67%]，p=0.015）。

summary_zh:
背景/目的：冷冻球囊（cryoballoon，CB）简化了用于治疗心房颤动（atrial fibrillation，AF）的肺静脉隔离（pulmonary vein isolation，PVI）。静脉闭塞通常借助对比剂进行评估，而对比剂使用可能带来风险，并增加透视曝光。以压力指导评估闭塞已成为一种潜在的替代方法。本研究旨在比较压力指导与对比剂指导评估静脉闭塞的操作特征及重复手术所见。

方法：自2018年7月至2023年12月，单中心连续纳入1166例接受CB-PVI的AF患者（485例[41%]为女性，平均年龄65 ± 10岁；64%为阵发性AF），其中368例（32%）采用对比剂指导方法，798例（68%）采用压力指导方法。

结果：压力指导组与对比剂指导组的手术时长（90 ± 20 vs. 93 ± 23 min）和消融时间（1342 ± 361 vs. 1368 ± 406 s）相近，两组的PVI急性成功率均较高。压力指导方法的X线曝光时间更短（5.7 ± 3.4 vs. 9.5 ± 4.8 min，p < 0.0001），X线剂量更低（82 ± 78.9 vs. 586 ± 546 cGy/cm2，p < 0.0001）。在112例因CB-PVI后心律失常复发而再次手术的病例中，压力指导手术后观察到全部静脉持久隔离的情况更常见（28/56 [50%] vs. 13/56 [23%]）；按静脉计算的持久隔离率也更高（174/224 [78%] vs. 150/224 [67%]，p = 0.015）。

结论：CB-PVI期间的压力波形指导是替代对比剂指导闭塞评估的一种可行方法，并与术中透视曝光显著降低相关。再次手术所见提示可能存在持久性信号，但该观察应视为探索性结果，并需在前瞻性研究中加以证实。

title: Efficacy and Safety of Vernakalant for Cardioversion of Atrial Fibrillation and Flutter: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary: Background/Objectives: Vernakalant is an atrial-selective antiarrhythmic used for rapid pharmacological cardioversion of recent-onset atrial fibrillation. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the efficacy and safety of vernakalant compared with placebo, active antiarrhythmic therapy, and electrical cardioversion. Methods: PubMed, Embase, Google Scholar, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) were searched from inception to August 2026. Randomized clinical trials, clinical trials, and comparative observational studies evaluating vernakalant in adults with atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter were included. Dichotomous outcomes were pooled as risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using the Mantel-Haenszel random-effects model in RevMan 5.4. Results: Twenty controlled studies involving 4523 patients were included, of whom 2349 received vernakalant and 2174 received control therapy. Vernakalant significantly increased successful conversion to sinus rhythm compared with all controls (1234/2244 (55%) vs. 991/2147 (46.2%); RR = 1.63; 95% CI [1.34, 1.99]; p < 0.00001). The effect was strongest versus placebo (RR = 5.33; 95% CI [1.95, 14.60]; p = 0.001) and remained significant versus procainamide (111/178 (62.3%) vs. 83/172 (48.2%); RR = 1.29; 95% CI [1.07, 1.57]; p = 0.009) and flecainide (209/280 vs. 209/330 (63.3%); RR = 1.18; 95% CI [1.05, 1.33]; p = 0.007), but non-significant against amiodarone, propafenone, ibutilide, or electrical cardioversion. Safety outcomes did not differ significantly between groups, including all-cause mortality (RR = 1.23), drug discontinuation (RR = 0.98), serious adverse events (RR = 0.87), ventricular tachycardia (RR = 0.68), bradycardia (RR = 1.31), and hypotension (RR = 0.80). Conclusions: Vernakalant was associated with higher rates of conversion to sinus rhythm, while no statistically significant differences were observed in major safety outcomes. These findings support its use as a pharmacological option for rapid rhythm restoration in appropriately selected patients.

AI.tldr: 纳入20项对照研究、4523例房颤或房扑患者的荟萃分析显示，维纳卡兰较对照显著提高转复窦性心律成功率（55% vs 46.2%，RR 1.63），主要安全性终点与对照无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 近期发作的房颤需要快速恢复窦性心律，药物复律可避免镇静与电复律相关风险。维纳卡兰是心房选择性抗心律失常药，但既往单项研究样本量有限、对照设置不一（安慰剂、其他抗心律失常药、电复律），其相对疗效与安全性缺乏系统量化证据。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析。检索 PubMed、Embase、Google Scholar 及 Cochrane CENTRAL，时间自建库至2026年8月。纳入评估成人房颤或房扑患者使用维纳卡兰的随机临床试验、临床试验及比较性观察研究。二分类结局以风险比（RR）及95%置信区间（CI）合并，采用 RevMan 5.4 的 Mantel-Haenszel 随机效应模型。
AI.result: 共纳入20项对照研究、4523例患者，其中维纳卡兰组2349例、对照组2174例。与全部对照相比，维纳卡兰显著提高转复窦性心律成功率：1234/2244（55%）vs 991/2147（46.2%），RR=1.63，95%CI 1.34–1.99，p<0.00001。亚组对比中，与安慰剂的差异最明显（RR=5.33，95%CI 1.95–14.60，p=0.001）；优于普鲁卡因胺（62.3% vs 48.2%，RR=1.29，95%CI 1.07–1.57，p=0.009）和氟卡尼（209/280 vs 209/330（63.3%），RR=1.18，95%CI 1.05–1.33，p=0.007）；与胺碘酮、普罗帕酮、伊布利特及电复律比较差异无统计学意义。安全性方面，全因死亡（RR=1.23）、停药（RR=0.98）、严重不良事件（RR=0.87）、室性心动过速（RR=0.68）、心动过缓（RR=1.31）及低血压（RR=0.80）在组间均无显著差异，相应的95%CI与P值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在适当筛选的近期发作房颤患者中，维纳卡兰可显著提高药物转复窦性心律的成功率，且未观察到主要安全性结局的显著恶化，支持其作为快速恢复节律的药物选择。但本分析未能证明其优于胺碘酮、普罗帕酮、伊布利特或电复律，纳入研究在对照类型与人群上存在异质性，摘要亦未报告安全性指标的置信区间及异质性检验结果，结论应用于临床决策时需结合患者基础心脏病与血流动力学状态谨慎判断。

summary_zh:
背景/目的：维纳卡兰是一种心房选择性抗心律失常药，用于近期发作的房颤快速药物复律。本系统综述和荟萃分析评估了维纳卡兰与安慰剂、活性抗心律失常药物治疗及电复律相比的有效性和安全性。

方法：检索PubMed、Embase、Google Scholar和Cochrane对照试验中心注册库（CENTRAL），检索时间自建库至2026年8月。纳入评估维纳卡兰用于成人房颤或房扑的随机临床试验、临床试验和比较性观察性研究。二分类结局使用RevMan 5.4中的Mantel-Haenszel随机效应模型，合并为风险比（RR）及95%置信区间（CI）。

结果：共纳入20项对照研究，涉及4523例患者，其中2349例接受维纳卡兰治疗，2174例接受对照治疗。与所有对照相比，维纳卡兰显著提高了成功转复为窦性心律的比例（1234/2244（55%）对991/2147（46.2%）；RR = 1.63；95% CI [1.34, 1.99]；p < 0.00001）。与安慰剂相比效应最强（RR = 5.33；95% CI [1.95, 14.60]；p = 0.001），与普鲁卡因胺（111/178（62.3%）对83/172（48.2%）；RR = 1.29；95% CI [1.07, 1.57]；p = 0.009）和氟卡尼（209/280对209/330（63.3%）；RR = 1.18；95% CI [1.05, 1.33]；p = 0.007）相比仍有统计学显著性，但与胺碘酮、普罗帕酮、伊布利特或电复律相比无统计学显著性。安全性结局在组间无显著差异，包括全因死亡（RR = 1.23）、药物停用（RR = 0.98）、严重不良事件（RR = 0.87）、室性心动过速（RR = 0.68）、心动过缓（RR = 1.31）和低血压（RR = 0.80）。

结论：维纳卡兰与更高的窦性心律转复率相关，而在主要安全性结局方面未观察到统计学显著差异。这些发现支持将其作为经适当选择患者快速恢复心律的一种药物治疗选择。

title: Safety, Efficacy, and Effectiveness of Pulsed Field Ablation with Farapulse™ to Treat Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Single-center Study
Transient Ischemic Attack Due to Delamination of a Steerable Guiding Sheath: A Potential Complication During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation
Ablation in Dextrocardia With Interrupted Inferior Vena Cava and Azygos Continuation to Coronary Sinus.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation ablation in dextrocardia with interrupted inferior vena cava presents formidable technical challenges, particularly when anomalous systemic venous return distorts interatrial septal relationships.

CASE SUMMARY: A 58-year-old man with drug-refractory paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, situs inversus totalis with dextrocardia, and inferior vena cava interruption with azygos continuation to the coronary sinus underwent catheter ablation. Lacking an inferior route, a superior approach through the left internal jugular vein was selected. Under intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) guidance, transseptal access was obtained using a dedicated wire-based system. Pulmonary vein isolation and roofline ablation were safely completed using radiofrequency energy.

DISCUSSION: Azygos continuation to the coronary sinus drastically distorts interatrial geometry. ICE-guided, wire-based transseptal access via a superior route is a safe, practical alternative when conventional inferior access is unavailable and needle-based puncture poses high risks.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: In situs inversus, the left internal jugular vein offers an optimal trajectory for transseptal puncture via a superior approach. Using a dedicated transseptal guidewire instead of a rigid needle, strictly guided by ICE, reduces the risk of mechanical complications during atypical transseptal punctures in complex congenital heart disease.

AI.tldr: 在1例内脏反位伴右位心、下腔静脉中断经奇静脉引流至冠状静脉窦的难治性阵发性AF患者中，经左颈内静脉上入路、ICE指导下导丝房间隔穿刺，安全完成PVI与顶部线消融。
AI.motivation: 右位心合并下腔静脉中断时，异常体静脉回流使房间隔解剖关系严重变形，常规经下腔静脉房间隔穿刺路径不可用，针穿刺并发症风险高；复杂先天性心脏病合并AF的消融入路与穿刺策略证据有限。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。58岁男性，药物难治性阵发性AF，全内脏反位伴右位心，下腔静脉中断、奇静脉延续至冠状静脉窦。因无下腔路径，选择左颈内静脉上入路；在ICE指导下使用专用线导丝系统完成房间隔穿刺，采用射频能量行PVI和顶部线消融。终点为手术能否安全完成及围术期并发症（摘要未报告随访与统计比较）。

AI.conclusion: 对于内脏反位、下腔静脉中断且奇静脉引流至冠状静脉窦的AF患者，左颈内静脉上入路配合ICE引导的线导丝房间隔穿刺可作为替代策略，可能降低非典型穿刺的机械并发症风险；但证据仅来自单例，需更多病例验证其可重复性与安全性。

summary_zh:
背景：在右位心合并下腔静脉中断的患者中进行心房颤动消融存在巨大的技术挑战，尤其是当异常的系统静脉回流扭曲了房间隔的解剖关系时。

病例摘要：一名58岁男性，患有药物难治性阵发性心房颤动、全内脏反位伴右位心，以及下腔静脉中断伴奇静脉延续至冠状静脉窦，接受了导管消融。由于缺乏下方入路，选择了经左侧颈内静脉的上方入路。在心脏内超声（ICE）引导下，使用专用的导丝系统完成房间隔穿刺。使用射频能量安全完成了肺静脉隔离和顶部线消融。

讨论：奇静脉延续至冠状静脉窦会严重扭曲房间隔的几何形态。当常规下方入路不可用且基于穿刺针的穿刺风险较高时，经上方入路、在ICE引导下采用基于导丝的房间隔穿刺是一种安全、实用的替代方案。

要点信息：在内脏反位中，左侧颈内静脉为经上方入路行房间隔穿刺提供了最佳轨迹。使用专用的房间隔穿刺导丝代替硬质穿刺针，并在ICE的严格引导下操作，可降低复杂先天性心脏病中非典型房间隔穿刺过程中机械并发症的风险。

title: Pregnancy-Related Right Atrial Appendage Tachycardia Requiring ECMO and Hybrid Ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Right atrial appendage atrial tachycardia (AT) during pregnancy is rare and can progress to tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy and shock.

CASE SUMMARY: A 22-year-old woman at 36 weeks and 5 days of gestation presented with fatigue, dyspnea, and narrow-complex tachycardia at 190-210 beats/min. Echocardiography showed an ejection fraction of 18%. After failed medical therapy, cardioversion, and esophageal pacing, she underwent emergency cesarean delivery and venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. Mapping localized the AT to the base of the right atrial appendage; endocardial radiofrequency (RF) and pulsed field ablation produced only transient sinus rhythm. Thoracoscopic bipolar RF ablation with surgical clamping restored durable sinus rhythm.

CONCLUSIONS: Appendage-origin AT in pregnancy can progress rapidly to tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy, and timely venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support improves the prognosis. RF and pulsed field ablation may be insufficient for deep or possibly epicardial substrates; surgical ablation should be considered when catheter ablation fails.

AI.tldr: 22岁孕妇36+5周发生右心耳房速并心动过速性心肌病（EF 18%），紧急剖宫产及VA-ECMO后，导管RF/PFA仅短暂恢复窦律，胸腔镜双极RF消融获持久窦律。
AI.motivation: 妊娠期右心耳起源房性心动过速罕见，可迅速进展为心动过速性心肌病和休克；既往证据多为零散病例，对导管消融失败后的策略选择缺乏明确经验。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为22岁、孕36周5天女性，表现为乏力、呼吸困难及窄QRS波心动过速190-210次/分，超声心动图LVEF 18%。在药物治疗、电复律及食管起搏失败后行急诊剖宫产并VA-ECMO；采用三维电解剖标测定位房速起源，评估心内膜射频消融、脉冲场消融及胸腔镜双极射频消融的节律转归。无正式主要/次要终点，观察指标为急性及持久窦性心律恢复。
AI.result: 标测将房速定位于右心耳基底部；心内膜射频消融和脉冲场消融仅短暂恢复窦性心律。随后行胸腔镜双极射频消融联合外科夹闭，恢复持久窦性心律。摘要未报告随访时间及LVEF恢复情况。
AI.conclusion: 妊娠期右心耳起源房速可快速进展为心动过速性心肌病，及时VA-ECMO支持可改善预后；对深部或可能心外膜基质，导管射频及脉冲场消融可能不足，导管消融失败时应考虑外科消融。结论受限于单例报告，需更多病例验证。

summary_zh:
背景：妊娠期右心耳房性心动过速（AT）罕见，并可进展为心动过速性心肌病和休克。

病例摘要：一名妊娠36周5天的22岁女性因乏力、呼吸困难及190～210次/分的窄QRS波心动过速就诊。超声心动图显示射血分数为18%。在药物治疗、心脏电复律及食管起搏均失败后，她接受了急诊剖宫产及静脉-动脉体外膜肺氧合。标测将AT定位于右心耳基底部；心内膜射频（RF）消融和脉冲场消融仅产生短暂窦性心律。胸腔镜下双极RF消融联合外科夹闭恢复了持久窦性心律。

结论：妊娠期起源于心耳的AT可迅速进展为心动过速性心肌病，及时给予静脉-动脉体外膜肺氧合支持可改善预后。RF消融和脉冲场消融对于深部或可能位于心外膜的基质可能不足；当导管消融失败时，应考虑外科消融。

title: An Adrenal Adenoma as the Culprit Behind 30 Years of Recurrent Syncope.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Primary aldosteronism (PA) is a treatable endocrine cause of secondary hypertension and, rarely, ventricular tachycardia (VT), syncope, or sudden cardiac death.

CASE SUMMARY: A 59-year-old woman with hypertension presented with recurrent syncope for 30 years, worsening over 2 weeks. Electrocardiogram showed multifocal premature ventricular complexes (PVCs), with one dominant morphology triggering predominantly monomorphic VT, plus corrected QT interval prolongation. Hypokalemia, renal potassium wasting, left ventricular enlargement, and mild systolic dysfunction were also present. Ventricular arrhythmias recurred despite electrolyte repletion, beta-blocker therapy, and radiofrequency catheter ablation. A positive saline infusion test and a 3.6-cm left adrenal adenoma supported PA. After adrenalectomy, potassium normalized, palpitations improved, VT burden decreased, and syncope did not recur at 1 month.

DISCUSSION: PA may present primarily with ventricular arrhythmias and syncope. In patients with ventricular arrhythmias accompanied by hypertension and hypokalemia, PA should be considered as a treatable endocrine-metabolic cause.

AI.tldr: 一例59岁女性因左侧肾上腺腺瘤所致原发性醛固酮增多症，表现为长达30年的复发性晕厥和多形性室早、单形性室速，肾上腺切除后血钾正常、室速负荷下降、晕厥未再发作。
AI.motivation: 原发性醛固酮增多症是继发性高血压可治疗的内分泌病因，罕见情况下可伴发室性心动过速、晕厥甚至心脏性猝死；临床上对以室性心律失常和晕厥为首发或主要表现、同时合并高血压与低钾血症的患者，是否应筛查 PA 仍认识不足，容易长期漏诊并反复接受无效的抗心律失常治疗与消融。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（JACC Case Rep）。对象为59岁合并高血压的女性，主诉复发性晕厥30年、近2周加重。检查包括心电图（多源性室早，其中一种优势形态触发以单形性为主的室速，伴QTc延长）、血钾与肾性失钾评估、超声心动图（左室扩大、轻度收缩功能不全）、盐水输注试验及肾上腺影像。干预为电解质补充、β受体阻滞剂、射频导管消融，最终行肾上腺切除术；结局为血钾、心悸症状、室速负荷及晕厥复发情况。样本量与统计方法：摘要未报告。
AI.result: 室性心律失常在纠正电解质、β受体阻滞剂及射频消融后仍复发。盐水输注试验阳性，并发现3.6 cm左侧肾上腺腺瘤，支持原发性醛固酮增多症诊断。行肾上腺切除术后血钾恢复正常，心悸改善，室速负荷下降，随访1个月晕厥未再发作。摘要未报告具体血钾数值、室速负荷量化数据及随访心电监测参数。
AI.conclusion: 原发性醛固酮增多症可以室性心律失常和晕厥为主要临床表现；对合并高血压、低钾血症（尤其伴肾性失钾）的室性心律失常患者，应筛查 PA 这一可治疗的内分泌代谢病因，针对病因的肾上腺切除可能降低心律失常负荷并防止晕厥复发。局限性为单例报告、随访仅1个月，因果关系与疗效仍需更大样本前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：原发性醛固酮增多症（PA）是继发性高血压的一种可治疗的内分泌性病因，罕见情况下也可导致室性心动过速（VT）、晕厥或心脏性猝死。

病例摘要：一名59岁女性高血压患者因反复晕厥30年就诊，近2周加重。心电图显示多源性室性期前收缩（PVCs），其中一种优势形态触发了以单形性VT为主的室性心动过速发作，并伴有校正QT间期延长。患者还存在低钾血症、肾性失钾、左心室增大和轻度收缩功能障碍。尽管进行了电解质补充、β受体阻滞剂治疗和射频导管消融，室性心律失常仍反复发作。生理盐水输注试验阳性以及3.6 cm左肾上腺腺瘤支持PA诊断。肾上腺切除术后，血钾恢复正常，心悸改善，VT负荷减少，1个月时晕厥未再复发。

讨论：PA可以主要以室性心律失常和晕厥为首发表现。对于伴有高血压和低钾血症的室性心律失常患者，应将PA视为一种可治疗的内分泌代谢性病因。

title: Durability and Safety of Superior Vena Cava Isolation With a Lattice-Tip Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter: Focal Versus Circumferential Lesion Sets.
Machine Learning Integration of Ablation Quality Metrics for Predicting Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence: A Multicenter Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Current prediction models for atrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence after ablation rely predominantly on nonmodifiable clinical characteristics, demonstrating limited predictive accuracy and offering little guidance for intraprocedural decision-making and outcome optimization.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to develop and externally validate a machine learning model that integrated clinical characteristics with ablation quality metrics to individually predict AF recurrence.

METHODS: We conducted a multicenter, retrospective cohort study of patients undergoing their first AF ablation in 14 hospitals from mainland China. Patients aged 18 to 80 years were enrolled, and data on clinical characteristics and quality metrics were collected. An XGBoost model was developed using 7 selected features to predict 1-year AF recurrence. The model was developed using 5-fold cross-validation for internal validation and was further externally validated on data from 2 independent hospitals.

RESULTS: Among 1,782 patients enrolled between December 2021 and December 2023, 294 (16.5%) experienced AF recurrence within 1 year. The final XGBoost model achieved strong discrimination in internal validation (area under the curve [AUC]: 0.918, 95% CI: 0.874-0.962). In feature-combination analyses, model performance improved from an AUC of 0.588 using clinical features alone to 0.918 after incorporating ablation quality metrics. In 2 independent external validation centers (n = 239), the model showed good discrimination, with AUCs of 0.992 and 0.951 and precision-recall AUCs of 0.960 and 0.815, respectively.

CONCLUSIONS: Integrating ablation quality metrics yielded an validated model that showed strong discrimination for 1-year AF recurrence, outperforming clinical features alone. This approach highlights the prognostic value of intraprocedural quality assessment and may support personalized patient management.

AI.tldr: 多中心回顾性研究纳入1782例首次房颤消融患者，基于7个特征构建的XGBoost模型整合消融质量指标后，1年房颤复发预测AUC由0.588提升至0.918，外部验证AUC达0.951-0.992。
AI.motivation: 现有房颤消融术后复发预测模型主要依赖不可改变的临床特征，预测准确性有限，且难以指导术中决策与结局优化。研究旨在构建并外部验证一个整合临床特征与消融质量指标的机器学习模型，实现个体化复发预测。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性队列研究，纳入中国大陆14家医院接受首次房颤消融、年龄18-80岁的患者，收集临床特征与消融质量指标。以7个筛选特征构建XGBoost模型预测1年房颤复发，采用5折交叉验证进行内部验证，并在2家独立医院的数据上进行外部验证。终点为术后1年房颤复发。
AI.result: 2021年12月至2023年12月共纳入1782例患者，294例（16.5%）在1年内复发。最终XGBoost模型内部验证AUC为0.918（95%CI 0.874-0.962）。特征组合分析中，仅用临床特征时AUC为0.588，加入消融质量指标后升至0.918。两家外部验证中心（n=239）AUC分别为0.992与0.951，PR-AUC分别为0.960与0.815。
AI.conclusion: 整合术中消融质量指标可显著提升1年房颤复发的预测判别力，优于单纯临床特征模型，提示术中质量评估具有预后价值，有望支持个体化患者管理；但作为回顾性研究，外部验证样本量较小（n=239），且摘要未报告校准度与决策曲线等更多验证指标，尚需前瞻性研究确认其临床效用。

summary_zh:
背景：目前用于预测消融术后心房颤动（AF）复发的模型主要依赖于不可改变的临床特征，预测准确性有限，并且对术中决策和结局优化指导甚少。

目的：本研究旨在开发并外部验证一个整合临床特征与消融质量指标的机器学习模型，以个体化预测AF复发。

方法：我们开展了一项多中心回顾性队列研究，纳入中国大陆14家医院首次接受AF消融的患者。纳入年龄18至80岁的患者，并收集临床特征和质量指标数据。使用7个选定特征开发了一个XGBoost模型，用于预测1年AF复发。该模型采用5折交叉验证进行内部验证开发，并在2家独立医院的数据上进一步进行外部验证。

结果：在2021年12月至2023年12月期间纳入的1,782例患者中，294例（16.5%）在1年内发生AF复发。最终XGBoost模型在内部验证中表现出较强的区分能力（曲线下面积[AUC]：0.918，95% CI：0.874-0.962）。在特征组合分析中，模型性能从仅使用临床特征的AUC 0.588提高至整合消融质量指标后的0.918。在2个独立外部验证中心（n = 239）中，模型显示出良好的区分能力，AUC分别为0.992和0.951，精确率-召回率AUC分别为0.960和0.815。

结论：整合消融质量指标所构建的经过验证的模型对1年AF复发表现出较强的区分能力，优于仅使用临床特征。该方法突显了术中质量评估的预后价值，并可能支持个体化患者管理。

title: Atrial cardiomyopathy: from knowledge gaps to clinical impact : The role of the EmbRACE Network.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial cardiomyopathy (AtCM) is increasingly recognised as an underlying atrial substrate contributing to atrial fibrillation (AF), heart failure (HF), and cardio-embolic stroke. However, diagnostic criteria, disease thresholds, and targeted treatment strategies remain poorly defined.

OBJECTIVE: To describe the rationale, structure, and translational strategy of the EmbRACE (Electro-Molecular Basis and the theRapeutic management of Atrial Cardiomyopathy, fibrillation and associated outcomEs) network, a national consortium established to address key knowledge gaps in AtCM.

METHODS: EmbRACE integrates mechanistic research, computational modelling, clinical trials, and implementation science within seven interconnected work packages. Human atrial tissue biobanking and deep phenotyping (WP1) enable molecular profiling of candidate pathways (WP2), which are validated in experimental models (WP3). Computational modelling and artificial intelligence (WP4) integrate multimodal clinical and biological data to derive composite AtCM phenotypes and severity frameworks. Substrate-targeting clinical trials evaluate AF ablation (RACE X; WP5), weight reduction using GLP‑1 agonists (DUTCH-WAIST; WP6), and optimised rate control using calcium channel antagonists (SMART-VERAPAF; WP6). Implementation science (WP7) focuses on guideline integration, decision-support tools, and governance of AI-based risk models. EmbRACE establishes a translational pipeline from mechanistic discovery to clinical application. By integrating tissue-level insights with multimodal risk modelling and interventional trials, the consortium aims to define clinically meaningful AtCM thresholds, to validate indirect markers, and to determine whether targeted treatment modifies disease progression and clinical outcomes.

CONCLUSION: EmbRACE provides a multidisciplinary framework to transform AtCM from a theoretical construct into a clinically actionable entity, enabling earlier detection, improved risk stratification, and AtCM-directed therapy in cardiovascular prevention.

AI.tldr: EmbRACE 全国联盟以七个工作包整合人群房组织机制研究、计算建模与人工智能、基质靶向临床试验及实施科学，力图将心房心肌病从理论概念转化为可临床操作的诊疗实体；摘要未报告任何具体研究结果或效应量。
AI.motivation: 心房心肌病（AtCM）日益被认为是驱动心房颤动（AF）、心力衰竭（HF）和心源性栓塞性卒中的底层心房基质，但迄今诊断标准、疾病严重程度阈值以及针对心房基质的治疗策略均缺乏统一定义，导致临床上无法识别高危患者、也无法开展靶向干预。既往证据多来自单一机制研究或零散观察，缺少从组织分子机制到危险分层再到干预验证的完整转化链条，EmbRACE 网络即为填补这一缺口而建立。
AI.method: 本文为研究网络（国家联盟）的构架与转化策略描述性文章，非系统评价、非原始临床研究，摘要未报告入组患者数、随访时间、终点定义与统计方法。EmbRACE 设七个相互衔接的工作包：WP1 建立人心房组织生物样本库并开展深度表型；WP2 对候选分子通路进行分子谱分析；WP3 在实验模型中验证上述通路；WP4 以计算建模与人工智能整合多模态临床及生物学数据，构建复合 AtCM 表型与严重程度分层框架；WP5 开展基质靶向的 AF 消融试验（RACE X）；WP6 开展 GLP-1 受体激动剂减重试验（DUTCH-WAIST）与钙通道拮抗剂优化室率控制试验（SMART-VERAPAF）；WP7 实施科学研究，聚焦指南整合、临床决策支持工具及 AI 风险模型的治理。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量结果，包括各工作包的样本量、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值均缺如。可提取的仅为网络目标性表述：通过整合组织水平的机制发现、多模态风险建模与干预性试验，确定具有临床意义的 AtCM 阈值、验证可替代的直接/间接标志物，并判定靶向治疗能否改变疾病进展与临床结局；RACE X、DUTCH-WAIST、SMART-VERAPAF 三项试验的结果摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: EmbRACE 提供了一个多学科框架，旨在将 AtCM 从理论构念转变为可操作的临床实体，从而支持更早期检出、更优风险分层以及以 AtCM 为靶点的心血管预防策略。对电生理实践而言，其潜在影响在于为房颤消融、减重与室率控制等决策提供基于心房基质的患者选择依据，并推动 AI 风险模型的规范化治理。局限性明确：本文为研究设计/网络介绍，不含原始数据与验证结果，所有关于疗效与阈值的论断均有待各工作包完成后证实，且 AtCM 表型与影像/电学标志物标准化仍是未来难点。

summary_zh:
背景：心房心肌病（AtCM）日益被认为是一种潜在的心房基质，参与促成心房颤动（AF）、心力衰竭（HF）和心源性栓塞性卒中。然而，其诊断标准、疾病阈值和靶向治疗策略仍定义不清。

目的：描述EmbRACE（Electro-Molecular Basis and the theRapeutic management of Atrial Cardiomyopathy, fibrillation and associated outcomEs）网络的理论依据、结构和转化策略，该网络是一个为填补AtCM关键知识空白而建立的国家级联盟。

方法：EmbRACE在七个相互关联的工作包中整合机制研究、计算建模、临床试验和实施科学。人心房组织生物样本库和深度表型分析（WP1）使得对候选通路进行分子谱分析（WP2）成为可能，这些通路在实验模型（WP3）中得到验证。计算建模和人工智能（WP4）整合多模态临床和生物学数据，以推导出复合AtCM表型和严重程度框架。靶向基质的临床试验评估AF消融（RACE X；WP5）、使用GLP‑1激动剂减重（DUTCH-WAIST；WP6）以及使用钙通道拮抗剂优化心率控制（SMART-VERAPAF；WP6）。实施科学（WP7）侧重于指南整合、决策支持工具以及基于AI的风险模型治理。EmbRACE建立了从机制发现到临床应用的转化管线。通过将组织层面的见解与多模态风险建模和干预性试验相结合，该联盟旨在定义具有临床意义的AtCM阈值、验证间接标志物，并确定靶向治疗是否改变疾病进展和临床结局。

结论：EmbRACE提供了一个多学科框架，将AtCM从理论概念转变为临床可操作的实体，从而能够在心血管预防中实现更早检测、更好的风险分层和针对AtCM的治疗。

title: KDM-Net: a large-kernel and bi-mamba integrated network for 12-lead atrial arrhythmia classification.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Automatic recognition of atrial arrhythmias is important for early clinical screening and computer-aided diagnosis. Distinguishing atrial fibrillation from atrial flutter remains challenging because of their similar electrocardiographic manifestations andhigh risk of misclassification. This study aimed to develop an effective model for atrial arrhythmia classification with improved multi-lead feature utilization, long-range temporal modeling, and cross-patient generalization.

APPROACH: We propose KDM-Net, which takes12-lead electrocardiogram signals as input. The network employs a large-kernel K module to enhance the perception of waveform morphology and rhythm patterns, a D module to recalibrate and fuse multi-lead features, and a bidirectional Mamba-based M module tomodel long-range temporal dependencies. KDM-Net was evaluated on the combined CUSPH and PTB-XL dataset under an inter-patient protocol.

MAIN RESULTS: In five-fold cross-validation, KDM-Net achieved an average accuracy and F1-score of 96.04% and89.21%, respectively. On the independent patient-level test set, the accuracy and F1-score were 96.41% and 88.31%, respectively. On the CinC 2020 external test set, the model achieved an accuracy and F1-score of 91.14% and 80.41%, respectively. KDM-Netoutperformed several representative models in comparative experiments.

SIGNIFICANCE: KDM-Net effectively integrates multi-lead spatial information and long-range temporal dependencies, demonstrating strong recognition performance and promising cross-patientgeneralization. It provides an effective solution for the intelligent diagnosis of atrial arrhythmias.

AI.tldr: KDM-Net 以大卷积核与双向 Mamba 处理 12 导联心电信号，实现房颤与房扑分类，独立患者级测试集准确率 96.41%、F1 88.31%，外部测试集为 91.14% 与 80.41%。
AI.motivation: 房性心律失常的自动识别是早期临床筛查与计算机辅助诊断的关键环节，但房颤与房扑的心电图表现高度相似，误分类风险高。既往模型在多导联特征利用、长程时序依赖建模及跨患者泛化能力上仍有缺口，本研究拟构建改进的分类模型以解决上述问题。
AI.method: 方法学研究，提出深度学习模型 KDM-Net，输入为 12 导联心电信号：K 模块采用大卷积核增强对波形形态与节律模式的感知，D 模块对多导联特征进行重校准与融合，M 模块基于双向 Mamba 建模长程时序依赖。模型在 CUSPH 与 PTB-XL 合并数据集上以患者间（inter-patient）协议评估，采用五折交叉验证，并设独立患者级测试集与 CinC 2020 外部测试集，主要指标为分类准确率与 F1 值，并与多个代表性模型进行比较。样本量、各心律失常类别构成及具体统计检验方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 五折交叉验证平均准确率为 96.04%、F1 为 89.21%；独立患者级测试集准确率 96.41%、F1 88.31%；CinC 2020 外部测试集准确率 91.14%、F1 80.41%。对比实验中 KDM-Net 优于多个代表性模型（各对比模型的效应量与 P 值摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: KDM-Net 能有效整合多导联空间信息与长程时序依赖，在房颤/房扑分类上表现出较高识别性能及跨患者泛化潜力，可作为房性心律失常智能诊断的一种技术方案。局限性在于：摘要未报告样本量、类别分布及敏感度、特异度、AUC 等临床相关指标，外部验证仅来自单一公开数据集，尚缺乏前瞻性临床与多中心长程监测场景的验证，距离电生理临床工作流中的实际部署仍有距离。

目的：自动识别房性心律失常对于早期临床筛查和计算机辅助诊断具有重要意义。由于心房颤动与心房扑动的心电图表现相似且误分类风险高，二者之间的区分仍具有挑战性。本研究旨在开发一种有效的房性心律失常分类模型，改善多导联特征利用、长程时间建模和跨患者泛化能力。

方法：我们提出KDM-Net，其以12导联心电图信号作为输入。该网络采用大核K模块增强对波形形态和节律模式的感知，采用D模块重新校准并融合多导联特征，并采用基于双向Mamba的M模块建模长程时间依赖关系。KDM-Net在CUSPH与PTB-XL联合数据集上、采用患者间协议进行评估。

主要结果：在五折交叉验证中，KDM-Net的平均准确率和F1分数分别为96.04%和89.21%。在独立的患者水平测试集上，准确率和F1分数分别为96.41%和88.31%。在CinC 2020外部测试集上，该模型的准确率和F1分数分别为91.14%和80.41%。在对比实验中，KDM-Net优于多个代表性模型。

意义：KDM-Net有效整合了多导联空间信息和长程时间依赖关系，显示出较强的识别性能和有前景的跨患者泛化能力。它为房性心律失常的智能诊断提供了一种有效解决方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence Enabled Dielectric Fingerprinting of Arrhythmogenic Substrates: A Precision Paradigm for Tissue Characterization Guided Cardiac Electrophysiology.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Electrical and dielectric properties of the myocardium depend on its composition, fibrosis, edema, ischemia, and heat damage, and hence may play an important role in defining the electrophysiologic substrate. Local impedance and other impedance-based methods give information about these parameters that is available to clinicians, but not direct or substitutable for intrinsic conductivity and permittivity of the tissue. The use of artificial intelligence has been thoroughly studied for the ECGs, electrograms, images, and computational data analysis, but not for dielectric or impedance measurements.

OBJECTIVE: The study aims to review the scientific basis of dielectric properties of heart muscle critically in cardiology and electrophysiology, to differentiate between existing clinical and conceptual applications of myocardial dielectrics, and to estimate current and potential contributions of artificial intelligence to their interpretation.

DATA SOURCES AND STUDY SELECTION: The current work represents a structured narrative review in PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar databases from inception until May 2026 based on various combinations of keywords that refer to myocardial impedance, dielectric properties, conductivity, permittivity, local impedance, dielectric imaging, cardiac electrophysiology, catheter ablation, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. This review included experimental, ex vivo, animal, computational, and human studies related to myocardial dielectric properties and their use in electrophysiology. Evidence was classified according to four categories: direct human clinical evidence; preclinical/translation evidence; indirect evidence from related techniques; and extrapolation concept. As a result of heterogeneity between studies, sensing technologies, and outcomes, the results have been analyzed narratively.

KEY FINDINGS: Evidence regarding the usage of AI algorithms, which have been primarily trained on myocardial dielectric or catheter-based local impedance data, is extremely scarce and mostly consists of preclinical or ex vivo data. On the contrary, the majority of clinically used AI algorithms in the field of electrophysiology make use of ECG data, intracardiac electrogram data, image processing, or computational modeling without any inputs related to dielectrics or local impedance.

CONCLUSIONS AND IMPLICATIONS FOR PRACTICE: Dielectric sensing is an attractive supplement to traditional methods of voltage mapping and imaging, although the clinical readiness of dielectric sensing greatly varies depending on the application. At the present time, the existing data provide a basis for utilizing the local impedance measurement in the ablation procedure and evaluation of the myocardium properties, while the combination of artificial intelligence and dielectric sensing is still experimental. Before being introduced into the clinical electrophysiology practice, signal acquisition standardization and prospective multicenter trials are needed.

AI.tldr: 该结构化叙述性综述指出，心肌介电传感（含导管局部阻抗）可作为电压标测与影像的补充用于消融术中组织表征，但人工智能与介电或局部阻抗数据结合的证据仍局限于临床前与离体研究，尚未达到临床可用水平。
AI.motivation: 心肌的电学与介电特性取决于其成分以及纤维化、水肿、缺血和热损伤程度，因而可能对界定电生理基质具有重要价值。临床可获得的局部阻抗等阻抗类方法虽能反映上述参数，却不能直接替代组织固有电导率与介电常数。人工智能在心电图、心内电图、影像及计算数据分析中已被广泛研究，但在介电或阻抗测量领域几乎空白，本研究即针对这一证据缺口进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 研究类型为结构化叙述性综述，检索 PubMed、Scopus 与 Google Scholar 自建库至 2026 年 5 月，关键词涵盖心肌阻抗、介电特性、电导率、介电常数、局部阻抗、介电成像、心脏电生理、导管消融、机器学习与人工智能。纳入与心肌介电特性及其电生理应用相关的实验、离体、动物、计算及人体研究；证据按四类分级：直接人体临床证据、临床前或转化证据、相关技术的间接证据、外推概念。因研究间、传感技术与结局指标异质性大，采用叙述性分析；具体纳入文献数量摘要未报告。
AI.result: 关键发现：以心肌介电数据或导管局部阻抗数据为主要训练来源的 AI 算法证据极为稀少，且多为临床前或离体数据。相反，电生理领域多数已临床应用的 AI 算法使用的是心电图、心内电图、图像处理或计算建模数据，其输入不含任何介电或局部阻抗信息。摘要未报告具体的效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 介电传感是传统电压标测与影像方法的有吸引力补充，但其临床成熟度因具体应用而异。现有数据目前仅支持在消融术中应用局部阻抗测量以评估心肌特性，而人工智能与介电传感的结合仍处于实验阶段。在引入临床电生理实践前，尚需实现信号采集标准化并开展前瞻性多中心试验。局限性在于本文为叙述性综述，缺乏定量合并分析，且原始证据以临床前研究为主。

summary_zh:
背景：心肌的电学与介电特性取决于其组织构成、纤维化、水肿、缺血及热损伤，因此可能在界定电生理基质方面发挥重要作用。局部阻抗及其他基于阻抗的方法可向临床医生提供有关这些参数的信息，但这些信息并不能直接反映组织本身的电导率与介电常数，也不能替代它们。人工智能的应用已在心电图、心内电图、图像及计算数据分析中得到充分研究，但尚未用于介电或阻抗测量。

目的：本研究旨在批判性地回顾心肌介电特性在心脏病学与电生理学中的科学基础，区分心肌介电特性现有的临床应用与概念性应用，并评估人工智能在其解读方面当前及潜在的贡献。

数据来源与研究选择：本工作是一项结构化叙述性综述，检索 PubMed、Scopus 和 Google Scholar 数据库自建库至 2026 年 5 月的文献，检索基于涉及心肌阻抗、介电特性、电导率、介电常数、局部阻抗、介电成像、心脏电生理学、导管消融、机器学习与人工智能等关键词的各种组合。本综述纳入了与心肌介电特性及其在电生理学中应用相关的实验研究、离体研究、动物研究、计算研究与人体研究。证据按四类进行分级：直接的人体临床证据；临床前/转化证据；来自相关技术的间接证据；以及外推概念。由于研究、传感技术与结局之间存在异质性，结果采用叙述性方式进行分析。

主要发现：关于主要以心肌介电数据或基于导管的局部阻抗数据进行训练的人工智能算法应用，相关证据极为稀少，且多为临床前或离体数据。相反，电生理学领域临床使用的大多数人工智能算法利用的是心电图数据、心内电图数据、图像处理或计算建模，而没有任何与介电或局部阻抗相关的输入。

结论与实践意义：介电传感是传统电压标测与成像方法的一种有吸引力的补充，尽管介电传感的临床成熟度因应用不同而差异很大。目前，现有数据为在消融术中利用局部阻抗测量以及评估心肌特性提供了依据，而人工智能与介电传感的结合仍处于实验阶段。在引入临床电生理实践之前，尚需实现信号采集的标准化并开展前瞻性多中心试验。

title: Angry Purkinje Syndrome: A Review of Short-Coupled Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia with Quinidine Treatment.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (VT) mediated by short-coupled premature ventricular complexes in patients with recent myocardial infarction is termed 'Angry Purkinje Syndrome'.
